name: Hanzade Terrace Restaurant
location: Emin Sinan, Piyer Loti Cd. No:35, 34126 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: We had a fantastic experience at Hanzade Terrace Restaurant! Everything was perfect from start to finish. We ordered the grilled chicken, which was cooked to perfection—tender, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was warm and attentive, and to our delight, they offered us complimentary apple tea and dessert at the end. The atmosphere was cozy with a lovely view, making the whole meal even more special. Highly recommend!

Everything was excellent! We ordered the shrimp in sauce and also the big sharing plate. More than enough for 2 people. Everything was delicious!! You get to try a little bit of everything. The service was excellent, they were all really attentive and the food was served in record time! Highly recommend!

This is a lovely find, sea views, great atmosphere, lovely food. More sauces would be nice to have as an option, no chilli or mayonnaise sauces. Would defiinately recommend this place on a whistle stop tour. Staff are very pleasant and the food are a good portion size and served nice and hot 🔥 If your a vegetarian then this place isnt for you to be honest unless they introduce more Vegan options on the menu. All that aside it was a really nice meal and experience looking out over the bay.

This terrace is really comfy and cozy. The service is outstanding, and the food is absolutely delicious. The portions are huge! We ordered stuffed vine leaves as a starter, and honestly, it could have been a main course for me. 😅 For our mains, we had the rolled lamb and beef kebab and the stuffed meatball—both were amazing! I couldn’t finish mine because it was just too much food. If you’re really hungry, it’s definitely worth it. The price is also fair, considering how tasty the food is and the beautiful view.

Delicious food and very good service. There has a great view of sea. The restaurant free service dessert and apple tea after the meal. Waiter very nice and helpful.
Very recommended.

name: Mivan Restaurant & Cafe
location: Emin Sinan, Piyer Loti Cd. No:34, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
For dinner or for lunch Mivan will be always a good choice. I has been only 4 days in Istanbul and I came 2 times here: for the really good food and lovely service. I recommend all of you to have at least a meal here, I promise you will not regret!
Really nice place upstairs and also the price for the quality is top.
They also speak well English and always try to help tourist with a lot of kindness. A
Special thank to Said that has been perfect following all our requests at lunch and dinner. If I’ll be back in Istanbul I’ll return!

Mivian Restaurant & Cafe was one of the unexpected highlights of our trip. Tucked away from the tourist-heavy spots, this place offers not only great food but also a genuinely welcoming vibe. The staff were kind without being pushy, and they seemed to really take pride in their service.

The food was fresh and flavorful—especially the [insert your favorite dish if you want, like “lamb shank” or “meze spread”]. Portion sizes were generous, and the pricing felt more than fair given the quality and setting. We ended up staying longer just to enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and sip on Turkish tea.

The views from the outdoor seating area added to the charm. It’s the kind of place where you can unwind after a long day of sightseeing and feel a bit more local.

Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a calm, authentic meal experience in a cozy setting.

Easily the best place in the area and a must-try! The shrimp casserole was incredible—served sizzling hot with perfect seasoning. The chicken skewers were just as great, perfectly seasoned and unbelievably tender. Even the traditional Turkish dumpling dish (name escapes me) was spot on, with the smaller dumplings making each bite even better. Service was outstanding from start to finish, with the owner even sharing some great tips and advice. Highly recommend.

Our Airbnb was a couple of houses away from this place, and the owner recommended we come here: glad we listened to him, because the Adana kebab is out of this world! The service was amazing; we were given complimentary appetizers and tea, the service was amazing. Our waiter was very kind and attentive, the place is gorgeous, and everything I tried was delicious! A must try for dinner in Istanbul (and admire cute cats)

Initially I thought the 7000+ reviews must mean they are bought reviews, but I was happily wrong. This is a family business which has been going strong since the 1980s. One of the owners is there every night and serves the food to the tables, it was truly an exceptional experience.

The servings are quite large so keep that in mind before you fill up on the free entrees.

Unfortunately we only found this on the last night. Until next time Turkey.

name: FÜLANE RESTAURANT
location: Hoca Paşa, Dervişler Sokağı No:7 D:2, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: I loved everything about Fulane restaurant, its ambience,the soft lighting, and the food.  I ate too quickly and forgot to pause for a photo. The chicken salad was delicious and so was the ravioli. I enjoyed tasting Turkish beer and wine. I highly  recommend dinner in this restaurant. The fruit teas were a welcome  treat.

While in Istanbul, we had dinner at Fulane Restaurant, and it was a delightful experience. The atmosphere was peaceful, making it a perfect spot to unwind after a day of exploring.

We started with a mix of cold meze, served with warm flatbread—fresh and flavorful. For the main course, we had grilled sea bream, cooked to perfection with generous portions. Dining outdoors made the experience even more enjoyable, especially with a few friendly cats keeping us company!

Although we initially skipped dessert, the restaurant surprised us with a complimentary rice pudding to share—a thoughtful and heartwarming gesture that truly elevated our experience. A lovely place with great food and hospitality—definitely worth a visit!

Food and service were very good. Delicious foods, big portion. Baklava and tea as a gift
10/10⭐️🎁

A total gem of a restaurant close to the mosques and the palace. Great food, cocktails, service and gorgeous and friendly cats!
Turkish and Anatolian dishes we had were great, especially ottoman casserole. Iskinder , tabulle and kofte also fab. Thank you for the baklava on the house.
Cats rule in this restaurant - very friendly and cute - but they are looked after so don’t ask to play or be fed.

Please don’t be fooled by the 5-star ratings on this restaurant. The restaurant may have had better days before, but our experience today was horrible.

We were 3 people who ordered a lot of different varieties from the menu (from starters to mains) including a cocktail each.  The first starter only came after 40 minutes, the cocktail arrived after 50 minutes. Between every order, we waited for 15-20 minutes even though we were the only customers in the restaurant. The server ran to the shop to buy the alcohol, 15 minutes after we ordered the margarita.

The seabass grill and the mixed grill platter (1800 lira), was really dry and burnt. Not worth it at all.

There are a lot of restaurants with cats in Istanbul, but this place had 5-6 cats jumping from couch to couch and table to table. The cats kept jumping up close to the food/table and we kept asking the server  to help keep them away, but this continued on throughout the whole dinner. A really insanitary experience.

Overall, this was by far the worst dining experience we had during our trip, despite the glowing reviews. Definitely not worth it.

name: TurguT Restaurant Sirkeci
location: Hocapaşa mahallesi, Ebussuud Cd. plevne iş hanı numara 34/A, 34112 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I came here a bit randomly, looking at the menu from the outside. It looked good so I came in. Then it's been a wonderful experience, the main waiter being really kind, friendly, even explaining me not to take some bread in extra because I'll get some with my plate anyway. Thumbs up to the lentil soup that was really fresh with some small herbs in it. I took the beef Kebab that was also good, with some fresh vegetables, pilaf rice and a bit of fench fries. At the end of the meal I was even offered a tea and baklava, so nice !
It was an great experience, I am most likely to come back someday ! 😋

We had an amazing experience at this restaurant! Our waiter, Tuncay, was exceptionally attentive, incredibly fast, and provided outstanding service from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious—full of flavor and beautifully presented. The portion sizes were generous, making it great value for money. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience!

So far I've been here for 4 days  and the food here is OUTSTANDING! Would say this is restuarant at listed as Kebab shop.
Highly recommend We had - Lamb Testi kebap which brings its own celebration. 🤣
Iskender beef
Kilometres kuzu (lamb) came with complimentary bread/ puf ekmet dips and tea x2 rounds
The service was brilliant very entertaining.

Not your typical tourist trap like restaurant. The service, food and atmosphere is absolutely amazing.

This is my second time in Istanbul and finding a restaurant seems to have been a challenge for me, I'm very selective.  This place definitely ticked all the checkboxes. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.

Absolutely amazing experience! The food was incredibly delicious – every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with lovely live music that made the evening even more special. A huge shoutout to Ismail, who took such great care of us – super friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great food, excellent service, and a fantastic vibe. Will definitely be coming back!

name: Deraliye Terrace
location: Alemdar Mahallesi Ticarethane Sokakk. No:10 Teras Kat, Alemdar, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Beautiful view from the terrace. The food was good, we tried variety of meals. They have the best Katmer I have tried, with the very tasty icecream. Highly recommend for the expierence

Absolutely amazing meal at Deraliye Terrace with a stunning views of the Bosphorus, the Blue Mosque, and the Hagia Sophia.

Food was delicious and deserving of the Michelin recommendation. Staff were very attentive and hospitable, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Would recommend and would return!

The best food we tried in Istanbul! The taste is so rich we were mesmerized 🫰🏻
We had a Lamb Beyti Kebab with vegetables for a kid, the meat was tender. Kavun Dolmasi (Staffed melon) blowed my mind with mix of tender meat, nuts and berries with melon! The other dish Kuzu Incik (Lamb Shank) was also mouthwatering, mashed Aubergine complemented the meat perfectly 👍🏼
We also had a fruit plate, which is very large and of various fresh fruits!

The atmosphere was clay, with nice music, gentle waiters (some also speak Russian) and surely an amazing panoramic view 🧡

We will be back to this restaurant next time!

Excellent all around. We were here to celebrate my birthday and they went out of their way to make it very special. I had the tenderloin shish and my wife had the goose in a pastry shell. Beautiful view of the Blue Mosque as well as Hagia Sophia.

Thank you to the staff for making my birthday celebration a special one!

Service from Sado was amazing!
Nice view and good food.
But pricey for sure! At least €50 pp.

name: Luco Restaurant Rooftop Sirkeci
location: Hoca Paşa, Ebussuud Cd. No:21, 34112 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Fantastic food and amazing views! Well priced dishes that are so delicious we left very happy! They were so generous and brought us Turkish tea and baklava after our meal. This place is a hidden gem (and I mean hidden)! You enter through Raymond Blue Hotel lobby, take the elevator to the 5th floor, and then a set of stairs brings you up to their first of 2 rooftop views. The views from the very top is just amazing and the food makes it a perfect date night to enjoy the city views. Literally a must visit!

Stumbled upon this hidden gem rooftop restaurant and it was the most pleasant experience. Our server Mahmed and other staff members provided amazing hospitality as well. They were incredibly kind and took pride in their dishes. We had the adana kebab, walnut salad and kunefe. Every dish was excellent, highly recommend!
The atmosphere here was amazing! The staff were so welcoming and friendly. Kept offering me free tea which was so kind. The food here was also incredible. Really loved the sea bass. Would come back!
Very good location and the service is very nice. The view is awesome as the price is affordable. Very good deal. I really recommend this restaurant. It’s just in city centre and close to everywhere.

Luco Restaurant in Istanbul is an absolute must-visit! From the moment you step inside, the warm and inviting atmosphere sets the perfect tone for a memorable dining experience. The decor strikes a wonderful balance between modern elegance and cozy charm, with subtle lighting and well-chosen artwork adding to the ambiance.

The menu is a masterpiece, offering a blend of local Turkish flavors with a contemporary twist, and every dish is crafted with remarkable attention to detail. I highly recommend trying their signature dishes, which showcase the chef’s creativity and skill—each plate is a work of art that tastes as amazing as it looks. The freshness and quality of ingredients are evident in every bite!

The staff at Luco truly elevates the experience. They are incredibly attentive, knowledgeable, and passionate about making sure each guest feels welcome and well taken care of. Their recommendations were spot-on, and they went out of their way to accommodate our preferences.

Whether you're a local or just visiting Istanbul, Luco is a restaurant that shouldn’t be missed. The combination of impeccable service, outstanding food, and beautiful ambiance makes it worth every star in this 5-star review. I’m already looking forward to my next visit!

name: Seven Hills Restaurant
location: Cankurtaran, Tevkifhane Sk. No:8 Kat:3, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Beautiful view with spectacular setting at the top of this restaurant. It’s a shame the weather not so great when we visited, else it could be even more stunning. Food was good, we ordered some pasta, a platter and a lot of desserts to share. Service also great, the waiter was showing off his Chinese lol. The place was more or less crowded during brunch time.

Seven Hills offers unbeatable rooftop views of the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque truly one of the best vantage points in Istanbul. The ambience in the early morning is peaceful and quiet, offering a serene start to the day with a side of history.

The food is good but not exceptional, with prices leaning toward the higher end. While the experience is memorable, it feels a bit overpriced if you’re dining alone, especially since the location clearly caters to couples and groups looking for that iconic Istanbul moment.

Great for the view just be prepared to pay for it.

I have always appreciated Turkish hospitality and cuisine during my visits, but this time, the service and food truly exceeded my expectations. The staff's attentiveness and politeness made me feel like royalty. I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude, particularly to a waiter named Sahin, whose kindness stood out. I sincerely hope this won’t be my last visit to Istanbul and wholeheartedly recommend this wonderful hotel.

*Updated Jan 2025, menu attached*

When searching up best rooftop restaurants in Istanbul, this place is a sure pop up. No surprises there, the view was amazing and feeling the Bosphorus breeze was nothing short of peaceful. I would say that both the day scene and night scene is different so is up to your discretion.

Food wise I think it's not too bad. Isn't the best but you are definitely paying for the view more than food quality.

Just some caveat, it is busy. You might not get the table you desire so perhaps make a reservation. It's expensive too, perhaps not for the backpacker.

Went for late dinner at this ChatGPT recommended place near blue mosque. We also wanted seafood so decided to give it a go despite reading reviews on food being expensive and some mentions of average. Almost all the seafood choice was fried or bbq, which we didn’t want, we wanted something lighter.

Ordered seafood casserole, which was very sour. Returned it back to kitchen and it came back the same. Ordered some soup which was extremely diluted. Even the bread was cold and tasted like it’s put out for a long time. Hardly ate and had to eat MCD after. View was nice indeed with 2 viewing decks but does not justify the view, price and horrible food. Service was mediocre.

name: Old Ottoman Cafe & Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Cağaloğlu Hamamı Sk. No:17 D:J, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I really loved the dessert they gave us — it was the best I’ve had in any restaurant! The stew in the clay pot was a bit pricey and the portion was small, but the taste was great. There’s no service charge here, but the total price still isn’t exactly cheap.

The service was excellent. I really liked the smiles of the two brothers — we had great conversations over several days. Overall, I’m very satisfied. Highly recommended!

Excellent food for decent prices. As a tourist, my family and I tried a lot of Turkish food that lacked flavor and freshness, this restaurant had both. The flavors were incredible and there were so many excellent vegetarian choices. The staff were so kind to offer complimentary tea and dessert. If you come to Istanbul, you HAVE to eat here. What a lovely meal to end our trip. Thank you for the best food we had in this city!

Dishes in photos: Sultan’s vegetarian favorite, vegetarian clay pot kebab, fig dessert and semolina with ice cream

I had an exceptional dining experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely phenomenal, with each dish surpassing my expectations. The standout dish for me was the Oriental Clay Pot Kebab. Not only was it served in a unique and theatrical way that felt like a show, but the taste was out of this world. The combination of flavors and the tender meat made it a memorable highlight of the meal. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I highly recommend trying the Oriental Clay Pot Kebab if you visit!

We had an amazing dining experience at this restaurant – by far the best in Istanbul! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The service was impeccable, and the food was nothing short of exceptional. Every dish was bursting with flavor and aroma; you could tell they use only the freshest ingredients. We truly enjoyed every bite and the whole experience. If you’re in Istanbul, this place is a must-visit. Can’t wait to return!

Everything was amazing. The atmosphere was very cozy and warm, which was nice on a cold night. The staff was very attentive and helpful in explaining what all the dishes were. The food itself was also amazing.  My husband and I split the clay pot kebab with beef, and it was plenty of food for the both of us.  On top of that, the presentation of the dish was super cool! The desserts were all amazing, but my favorite was the katmer, I'd never tried it before, and it was so good. Definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for great food, great service, and a great atmosphere!

name: Köşk 1981 fish meat restaurant
location: Cankurtaran mahallesi Akbıyık Caddesi, Cankurtaran, Adliye Sk. no:9/a, 34400 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Perfect Date night for our Anniversary ♥️. The food is great we ordered Calamari, Spaghetti Bolognese and Clay Pot kebab (a must to order you will be surprise) and ice cream for dessert and of course the hot apple tea with complimentary of baklava. Ambiance was nice and relax, Staff are great and very friendly. Will recommend

We ate here twice in our stay and love the place. The prices are much better than what you find on the street next to it. They didn’t pressure us to come in like the other street. They were friendly and teased my 11 year old son a lot. He loved it. In fact it came back the second time we asked if my son‘s favorite antagonist was available and he wasn’t so they sent a picture of my son shaking his fist to him. It made his trip. The prices are extremely reliable they don’t try to sneak food into the bill and run honest business which is a big relief compared to a lot of the restaurants that we found out there.

Had the sea bass, it was fresh and tasty. Reasonably priced for the area. The Adana Kebab was very juicy. We ordered two Turkish teas but they didn't appear to charge us for this, (Though there was a tax of 125.40 lira, but perhaps this was a service charge?). They even gave us a further cup of Turkish tea for each of us and a piece of Baklava.

Honestly, it is my favourite restaurant in Istanbul. If I could give it higher than 5 stars, I would.
The hospitality is second to none.
The food is cooked to perfection and doesn't leave you hungry, trust me. They also have a sollid mix of seafood, meat, and vegetarian options.
Topped with a casual, cosy ambience.
Lovely atmosphere and friendly staff especially Musa. We ate/drank here a couple of times during our weekend in Istanbul and also tried the hookah.

name: By Ferro Fish And Kebab House
location: Emin Sinan, Kadırga Limanı Cd. No:85, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: This is a fun and friendly Turkish restaurant with great food and kind service. They staff are very attentive and take good care of you while dining. They make it a fun experience and also provided baklava and tea on the house. Highly recommend the grilled meat platter for a group of people.

Experienced the most delightful turkish hospitality with the most delicious authentic food, loved the mixed grill platter, they served the epitome of everything sumptuous for our first day in Turkey 😋👌🏼🇹🇷
Fantastic kebabs! The baklava was delicious! But the service and atmosphere were top notch! Great food and fun time! Highly recommend!

This restaurant staff were really sweet to my nephew. They gave him all the attention he wanted and gave him free snack at the end and tea for the adults. Very delicious food. And the restaurant vibe is really pretty.

We got here late on Saturday after a long bus trip to Turkey. The children were hungry so we decided to get a quick food for them without paying much attention to the price. We were charged 440 lira for a small plate of fried potatoes, 330 lira for a can of sprite. The kids ordered a salad and pasta and both of them came with chilli sauce on the plate which the children thought was tomato sauce so that didn't go well with them. The place is next to the main road so it was very busy with lots of cars passing by. We charged over 4100 lira for 4 soft drinks, 1 wine, 1 plate of fried potatoes, 1 plate of salad, 1 plate of cheese rolls. They gave us "free" tea and baklava when we asked for the bills.

name: Old hipodrom terrace restaurant
location: Küçük Ayasofya, Kaleci Sk. No:3, 34000 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: After traveling all day from the states we walked over and the service was very warm and welcoming. We ordered a seafood platter that was amazing! We were given some desserts which were also amazing. Their tea at the end of dinner was the cherry on top.

The food and service is amazing!  We purposefully walked here after exploring the area.  It has a mix of local and tourists.

The fire coals claypot lamb was the highlight for us! Even the mini dumplings hit the spot.

A place we plan to come back to!

Beautiful place! Food amazing and tasty!
Will come back for sure!
Sultan portion is the best! What an amazing combination!🤗💞
Best regards from Serbian girls!

We came to Old Hipodrom 3 nights in a row as their food is amazing and they had beer and wine. Not every restaurant in this area serves alcohol so this was the most convenient for us to have great food (and quite the selection such that I had a different main course each evening) and drinks in the same place! Their service was also amazing and they provided several complimentary items with our meals such as hot bread, mezze, Turkish tea, and delicious Turkish delight!! We bought a massive box of Turkish delight to bring home with us too! Highly recommend visiting this restaurant!

I was kinda afraid of the 5 star reviews. But I can confirm it isn't a scam! The restaurant has really good turkish food. Even if it is small, it has a nice atmosphere, good food and variety (they have vegetarian and even vegan options too). The prices are okay, however note they aren't the cheapest. They offer free meze in the beginning. At the end they also bring free tea.

name: Hidden Garden
location: Binbirdirek, Peykhane Cd. No: 14/A, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Hidden Garden Restaurant is a true hidden gem in the heart of Sultanahmet. As soon as you step into the garden, you’re welcomed by a peaceful, green atmosphere that feels like a calm retreat from the city’s hustle and bustle. The lush plants, charming decor, and cozy seating create a relaxing environment perfect for both lunch and dinner.

The food is equally impressive. The menu offers a wonderful selection of Turkish and Mediterranean dishes, each prepared with care and fresh ingredients. I especially enjoyed the mixed meze platter and grilled lamb skewers – both full of flavor and beautifully presented. The portions were generous, and everything tasted homemade and authentic.

The service at Hidden  Garden is truly outstanding. The staff are friendly, attentive, and very knowledgeable about the menu. They made sure we were comfortable throughout our meal, offering helpful suggestions and checking in at just the right times. Their hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable.

Whether you’re a tourist exploring the historical sites nearby or a local looking for a relaxing meal, Giden Garden is the perfect spot. I highly recommend it for anyone seeking great food, warm service, and a beautiful garden atmosphere.

Wonderful food. Great service from Sakir, Mario, Can, and the rest of the staff as well. Good atmosphere for us to rest, relax, and enjoy ourselves after a long day of walking around the city. Shout out for the complementary coffee & Baklava to close out this nice dinner.

Highly recommended!

Will definitely come again.

Came here due to the reviews and glad we did. Great Turkish restaurant with fantastic service and flavorful authentic food. We sat outside in the back and it was chilly but beautiful. Plus they had plenty of heaters around to make it comfortable. The bread was so fresh and delicious! Really enjoyed both entrees we got. And our service was fantastic with our server Percot - he was very accommodating and kind. Highly recommend!

Hidden Garden – A True Turkish Gem in Istanbul 🌿🇹🇷

Hidden Garden is a charming traditional Turkish restaurant tucked away just around the corner from the Blue Mosque. The atmosphere is cozy and authentic, especially the outdoor seating area.

The food was excellent! The hummus was especially flavorful and creamy, and the beef was incredibly tender and full of rich, delicious flavor. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared and true to Turkish tradition.

A special thanks to Sakir, who made the experience even more memorable. He was warm, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit—truly a gracious host who made us feel at home.

If you’re visiting Istanbul and looking for great food with genuine hospitality, Hidden Garden is a must. Highly recommended!

Sakir was such a wonderful person to chat with while I was here! Made me feel very welcome into Hidden Garden. Also the place has such a cute ambiance and is truly a hidden gem. I love places that are tucked away like this. I saw the door but when I went inside and down the stairs it opened into this beautiful patio surrounded by plants. I loved it. The food was superb and they make the best sangria I have had.

name: Las Tapas fish and kebap Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Çatalçeşme Sk. No:5, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We came to this restaurant based on the high ratings and they were justified. Firstly, the service was great, as they usually are in all these places. As for the food, we were given free naan as a starter so we ordered aubergine paste (baba ganoush) to go with it.

We had fried Atlantic mackerel which was so nice (crunchy and soft on the inside) as second starter and my wife had this fantastic grilled squid stuffed with mushroom and veggies. I had shish beef kebab, but I found the meat to be really tough, and compared to my wife’s grilled squid mine tasted quite boring.

We sat inside the restaurant in the mezzanine level, as it was quite freezing in late March in Istanbul and the interior was nicely decorated and had a very relaxed and cosy feel to it.

We ended the meal with some chocolate dessert as well as free Turkish tea and some baklava.

Overall, a very enjoyable evening.

From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and outstanding hospitality. The staff were incredibly attentive, friendly, and made us feel right at home.

The food was exceptional – every dish was full of flavour, beautifully presented, and perfectly cooked. You can tell a lot of care goes into their menu. A special mention for the complimentary tea, freshly baked bread, and baklava served on the house – such a thoughtful and generous touch that added to the charm of the evening.

Las Tapas isn’t just a meal, it’s an experience. Highly recommended and definitely a place I’ll be coming back to.

We received the special Turkish bread with olives as a starter - compliment from the place. The food was good but not something expectational. At the end we received tea and baklava again from the house. The staff was really polite and nice. For all the meals on the photos we paid 95€ (two adults and a child).

A 5/5 from the beginning to the end. I came here 3 days in a row and everything was flawless. I had turkish salad, stuffed eggplant, mackerel, stuffed squid, etc. The menu is gigantic and everything is fantastic. The place itself is cozy and warm and the service is super friendly and welcoming. I will recommend this place to everyone visiting Istanbul.

I had an amazing experience at this Turkish restaurant. The food was perfect, full of authentic Turkish flavors, and the ambiance was very cozy. The waiter was kind and welcoming, and they even treated us to free coffee and baklava. We had a delicious meal for two for less than 50 euros. Highly recommended!

name: Galata Sanat Restaurant Galata Köprüsü
location: Haliç tarafı, Rüstem Paşa, Galata Köprüsü altı no : 6, 34116 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Lovely aspect of the Bosphorus with lots of food options.

Really enjoyed the Sea Bass and skewered Lamb.

The Kunafe is out of this world and must be tried.

Service was good and nothing was too much trouble for them.

Being at a tourist destination, you sometimes get stung with extraordinary pricing and disappointing food...

Galata Sanat does not disappoint and leaves you wanting more!!

Tldr; like someone said this is a tourist trap. Price vs quality not worth it.

Personal opinion: I feel this place is paying for reviews otherwise I don't see how they have such high score with such average food and service.

The food is average, the service is poor and the location is nice.

We got rushed in and the server kept pushing us to order. We asked for advice and he seemed rushed to get us to close the deal. The fish in the window did look fresh which was a good sign and the reason we stayed. We ordered sea bass grilled and you can see from the pics this did not seem grilled. On top of that the server never provided the weight for the fish and charged us 2100 which was the price per kilo. Judge for yourself if that was 1kg of fish from the pic maybe we're wrong but definitely didn't seem like it.

The salads were just not good therefore we left them out.

The anchovies were quite good actually and did seem fresh. Sadly that was the only highlight of the entire evening.

Foods are delicious and the portions worth of money, staffs very kind and even give us free baklava n tea. Its our second time here and definitely will come back again! Lamb and meatballs so tasty! Thank you for the good ambiance live music good food n good people 😁

We came here for the famous sandwich. It wasn't on the menu, so we asked, and they said they had it. The sandwich was good. The restaurant is in a great location. If you're in the neighborhood, give them a try

1. The place everyone has to visit in Istanbul, under the Galata bridge
2. Big portions, reasonable price
3. Tasty, but meat was a bit dry
4. Nice and friendly staff
5. Wonderful views
Recommend

name: Mr Cook Restaurant
location: Mr Cook Restaurant, Alemdar, Molla Fenari Sk. No:33 A 34122, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: I loved this restaurant so much! The service was amazing, and shout out to Karam for the hospitality and kindness he showed me and my family. The food was delicious, and it is worth stopping by. Lovely restaurant and a lot of menu options. Thank you for the amazing experience, hope to return soon!

what a memorable experience !! Karam was AMAZING, he attended to us so well and was so kind and sweet! he gave us turkish tea & baklava on the house with my baby brothers name on it! (he loved him) the menu selection was wide & unique, and the food was amazing, the portions are huge! i recommend this place for sure!!

Mr cook is the best restaurant we ate at in Istanbul. We were there for the first time in 2015 and we remembered this delicious taste so much that we returned on our next visit to Istanbul this year, in 2024. The taste exceeded expectations, simply delicious, and the portions are large and filling. A place with a relaxing atmosphere and very nice staff. I recommend it with all my heart!

Great service and delicious food! We ordered the seafood tagliatelle and a pepperoni pizza, and a dessert of tiramisu, all were flavourful  and well done. Forgot to take pics till halfway through the meal

I stumbled across this restaurant by accident late at night. I came back again around lunch time, both times my table were the only people in the place. The food is portioned well and very tasty.
One thing I will mention which ended in a shame is they increased our bill — we ordered a cheese bread as a starter, and they tried to charge us as if it were a pizza, which made the cheese bread starter the same price as our main dishes. When I pulled them up on it and referred back to the menu they tried to tell me the cheese bread and pizza (with sauces and meat) were the same price….. since when does cheese and meat cost the same. I feel they/ most restaurants do this as an easy innocent way to increase your bill.

name: Resto Galata Terrace
location: Yavuz Sinan Mah.Ragıp Gümüşpala Cad, Resto Galata Terrace, Yavuz Sinan, Unkapanı Cd. No:69 kat 4, 34134 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
In October last, my brother and I were on our way to our hotel (HKK) after a day of exploring Istanbul, but were extremely hungry. A short walk through the neighborhood and along the water brought us to this Rooftop Restaurant.
We were warmly welcomed by very nice staff and decided to check out the menu here.  There is a wide variety of dishes, which made the choice quite difficult. In the end, we both went for a delicious meat dish with Sarma and a plate of spreads on the side.

We really enjoyed the ambiance and the wonderful view over the water, the bridges and the Galata Tower.

After dinner I decided to order dessert, I have no idea what it is called, but it was delicious! Soft, creamy, pistachio, not too sweet, highly recommended. The evening eloped for us and we decided to go back to our hotel. The staff asked us if we would come back again and of course we did.

After the demonstration regarding Palestine in Taksim Square was over, we returned for lunch with, of course, this delicious dessert again. This time the staff brought us desert with an extra nice surprise ❤️ My heart cried, what a sweet staff work here! After this they offered me something extra and gave me a delicious shisha.

Don't skip this place, the hospitality is phenomenal and the food is delicious!

This is the greatest restaurant in Istanbul. We are eating here for second year and we totally adore the food and the attitude of the staff. The meal is fresh and very tasty, you have a wonderful view to the Bosphorus and the Galata. They also complimented is with tea and baklava. The staff definitely knows how to spil you and make you feel special. We totaly recommend this restaurant as the best in the city!

I want to thank Nasser for service :)
Very delicious food, workers are nice and are very helpful. Prices are low enough. I would recommend this place to my friends. Thank you for your hospitality.

One of The best restaurants in Istanbul!
Fast and great service, amazing View, Delicious food and Shisha!
Don’t miss to ask for Mr. Hakan help , the best in their team in addition to the owner!
So recommended
I highly recommend this restaurant on the Bosphorus river front. The views are great and the service was good.

name: Deraliye
location: Alemdar Mahallesi Ticaret Hane Sokak Giriş Kat No 10, Alemdar, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We had a wonderful experience at Deraliye Ottoman Restaurant. The atmosphere is warm, elegant, and authentically decorated with beautiful traditional details.

We started with the mixed appetizer platter, served with fresh, warm bread – a perfect way to begin the meal. For mains, we ordered the Ali Nazik Kebab, Adana Kebab, and the Beef Tuffahiye. All three dishes were absolutely delicious, but the Beef Tuffaiye was a real highlight – tender, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

The service was excellent: very attentive, professional, and friendly throughout. What stood out to us was that there were no staff outside trying to bring people in – which is rare in this area. The place was fully booked anyway, so we were happy we made a reservation in advance.

Prices are a bit on the higher side, but absolutely fair for the quality, presentation, and overall experience. We would definitely come back and highly recommend this place!

I went in with high hopes but unfortunately was rather disappointed with the taste. I understand this is going to become a Michelin star restaurant but, I honestly could not appreciate the taste. We ordered most of the lamb dishes, but, they tasted rather bland and nothing special. We could have tried the vegetarian option, but, wasn't sure how that would turn out.
The tamarind aperitif and bread with goat's cheese were actually better than the main course itself.

It was an amazing experience. I reserved a table here for my girlfriend's birthday and their hospitality was truly something I've never experienced. !!! The food we ordered was very authentic Osmanlı cuisine and their meat and their dishes were truly amazing. The house wine was also very tasty.

Worth being called a Michelin restaurant. Will definitely come here again.

Wow such an incredible experience food aside - the service, attention, friendliness, top.

They have given us not only an incredible food experience from original Turkish meals and high quality, but the staff were so attentive and incredible. HIGHLY recommend, and yes, take the cooking class. Having a chef one on one with you is so special

wow! if you want to try something unusual you should come here. delicious ottoman cuisine, personal atmosphere, high service. the owner and chef of this restaurant cooked everything closer for the series Magnificent century. serving of some dishes today is the same as in the series. highly recommended, special thanks to the team of employees. celebrated mom's birthday separately congratulated her.

name: Eva Bosphorus Restaurant
location: DEMİRAY OTEL'İN ÜST KATINDA BULUNMAKTADIR, Hobyar, Hocahanı Sok. No:10, 34112 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Fantastic restaurant with an amazing view! We had mezze, grilled meat platter and grilled sea bass, all really tasty. The views are stunning out over the bospherus and over to galata tower. We even came back the next night for dinner! Thanks to Serdar, Sezar and Ismail for the fantastic service!
The place is fantastic and cozy. Well organised and clean. Service crew were nice and friendly. Food is delicious and price is affordable. 360 view of Bosporus. Well recommended. Five thumbs up!

From the restaurant's terrace, you can overlook the entire Bay Area while you enjoy your meal. This makes it the perfect spot for great pictures. It is not our first time in Istanbul, but it is our first time spending an entire week here. So, come and visit this spot if you want to see how immense Istanbul really is.

The ambiance at the restaurant is very pleasant. Music is playing all the time, but it only adds to the atmosphere and it is never so loud that you couldn't have a conversation.

The breakfast buffet has much to offer: fresh fruits, salads, and vegetables, as well as eggs, cheese, and many other Turkish specialties. Whether you prefer a cold or hot breakfast, I am sure you will find the right combination for your breakfast. An absolute delight.

The staff is super friendly, even if some of them don't speak English or just a few words. They will always do their best to accommodate you and fulfill any wishes and requests you may have, given that they are within reason, of course. Especially Efe was super attentive and always looking to provide good service to make us feel as comfortable as possible. If we come back again, we would for sure eat here again.

We stayed at Demiray Hotel for several days and visited this restaurant several times, for both breakfast and dinner and each time we really enjoyed it. The breakfast buffet is extensive and with excellent variety. At dinner, the atmosphere is relaxed but elegant, and the dishes are beautifully presented. Special thanks to Umit and Hayrettin for their attentive and friendly service. As for the view from the terrace, it simply cannot be any better. I could spend hours there taking in the huge number of things to look at from that vantage point.

If it was possible to give a higher rating - they would put

We came to this wonderful place on the first day of our arrival in Istanbul and knew for sure that we would definitely come to the last one again! That’s how it was and both times we met all our expectations for all 100

The service is amazing, the food is delicious, the rice is the best in all of Turkey. Many thanks to Sardar and the team for the warm welcome and very pleasant emotions!

name: Sirkeci Lokantası 1912
location: Hobyar, Rahvancı Sk. No:5, 34112 Sirkeci/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We came across this beautiful restaurant by chance after a long stroll through the bazaar. The beverages were refreshing and the desserts are absolutely delicious. Definitely try the Pistachio Brownie which is great for sharing.

The music is upbeat and the restaurant is absolutely beautiful -reminscent of an upscale Parisian restaurant. Thank you to the team who are very hospitable too!

The restaurant is a beautiful historic building that has incredible curb appeal, especially at night with the lighting. The restaurant was not busy when we visited. The decor, atmosphere, and lighting was beautiful and relaxing. Nice jazz music was playing. Service was slow and they forgot our Hummus order - came late and did not include any bread or preferably pita bread (maybe that is not the culture in Turkey, but wasn’t sure how to eat the hummus without any bread). The soup of the day was cream of zucchini, which was excellent. I had a beef tenderloin kebab, which was very expensive and just ok and a small portion considering there were pieces of fat between the meat, which I assume was there to keep it juicy. The side salad was a very large portion and very tasty and fresh. The meal was nearly $100 and consisted of beef tenderloin kebab,soup of the day, hummus, bottled water, and side salad.

Gul was so nice taking pictures of all the diners.  And making all the diners feel so welcome!   Amazing food. Order the artichoke salad as it’s amazing.  Salad dressing was made with lemon and orange essence.
The place is amazing and the atmosphere is so impressive. We had a chance to visit place. Service and staff are so communicative and helpful. Highly recommended :)

Yo, this place is pretty cool, and the service is on point!

It's a bit pricey, but it's worth it! The staff is super friendly and nice!

We went there for a birthday party and ordered a ton of food! I had the fettuccine Alfredo, and it was bomb! Highly recommend it. But the schnitzel was just okay. I wouldn't recommend that.

We had a little birthday thing with San Sebastian cheesecake. It was good, not the best I've ever had, but still good!

The views from the restaurant are amazing! You could totally take some sick pics there!

The staff is all really nice and chill!

But yeah, it's a bit expensive!

name: La Terrasse Karaköy
location: Kemankeş Karamustafapaşa Mah. Galata Şarap İskelesi Sok:6, Kemankeş Karamustafa Paşa, Vakıf Han No: 10/1, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
A Bosphorus Breakfast Haven with a Personal Touch*

Sitting at this gem, nestled right before Galata port mall, feels like the perfect Istanbul experience. The view of the Bosphorus is nothing short of fabulous—sunrise over the water, boats drifting lazily by, and the city coming to life. But what truly sets this place apart isn’t just the stunning backdrop; it’s Chef Mustapha. His passion for food is infectious, and his interaction with guests adds a warmth that’s hard to find elsewhere.

The breakfast spread is impressive, with a mix of classic Turkish flavors and creative twists. Every bite feels like a celebration of local ingredients, and the presentation is almost too beautiful to disturb (almost). The staff are friendly and attentive, moving with a calm efficiency that makes you feel right at home.

What makes this place exceptional is the personal touch that Chef Mustapha brings to every meal. Without him, it could easily be just another restaurant with a great view, but his dedication elevates the entire experience. Whether you're a local or a visitor, this spot is a must-visit. Start your day with breakfast here, then stroll over to Galata port mall for a seamless blend of relaxation and exploration.

*Highlights:*
- Chef Mustapha’s passion and interaction
- Stunning Bosphorus views
- Friendly, attentive staff
- Perfect location near Galata port mall

*Recommendation:* Don’t miss the chance to chat with Chef Mustapha—he’s as delightful as the food. And if you can, grab a seat by the window to soak in the view while you enjoy your meal.

La Terrasse Karaköy is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you’re wrapped in a warm, welcoming vibe that perfectly captures the spirit of Istanbul. The views are simply breathtaking — sweeping panoramas of the Bosphorus and the city skyline that make every moment feel special.

Mustafa, in particular, made the visit unforgettable. His genuine hospitality, attention to detail, and great recommendations added a personal touch that set the whole experience apart. You can tell he truly cares about every guest having an amazing time.

The small plates were a real highlight — every dish was thoughtfully prepared, fresh, and packed with flavor. Whether you’re nibbling on seafood, charcuterie, or one of their creative local twists, there’s so much to love in every bite.

The atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between lively and relaxed — ideal for a casual evening or a special celebration. I can’t recommend La Terrasse Karaköy enough. It’s one of those places you visit once and immediately start planning your return.

Amazing place. It was the highlight of our day in Istanbul. The food was absolutely delicious and fresh and the view was incredible. The hospitality was top notch.
Special thanks to Mustafa the manager of the place. .
I really recommend trying the kunafa as a dessert.  One of the best I've had in my life.  Highly recommended.

A hide place you must visit. You need to enter in the hotel and take the elevator to reach one of the best views in Istanbul. The service, food and location is more than excellent. The manager took its time to welcome you and help you to decide what to order.

I definitely have a mixed review. We ate here for lunch and the service was very good from Mustafa. However, the food left a lot to be desired. I had a chicken Caesar salad and the dressing was not made correctly at all-tasted like a totally different dressing. Turkish coffee was good. They brought us out something before the meal that looks like it’s on a hotdog bun, and we tried it and the flavors were not that good in the sauces-especially compared to some of the other Turkish restaurants we had been to on the trip. I would say this is a good place to go for drinks and fries-which had paprika and were very good.

name: Gülhane Şark Sofrası
location: Alemdar, Alayköşkü Cd. No:22, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
This restaurant is a hidden gem for anyone who wants to experience real Turkish cuisine! From the outside, it might not stand out, but once you step inside, you’ll be treated to an unforgettable dining experience.

The food is absolutely delicious – fresh, authentic, and full of flavor. Every dish is prepared with care and passion, and you can taste the quality in every bite.

The service is outstanding! The team is young, energetic, and incredibly friendly. They truly care about their guests, always making sure you feel welcome and taken care of. Whether you need a recommendation, have a special request, or just want a warm smile – they are always there for you.

The atmosphere is unique and special. The walls are covered with thank-you notes from visitors all over the world – proof of how many people have loved this place!

And the prices? Absolutely fair for the amazing quality and service you get.

If you are in Istanbul and want to enjoy great food and true Turkish hospitality, this is the place to go. We will definitely come back!

A jewel in the crown of Turkish restaurants! Excellent food provided by the folk at Gülhane Şark Sofrasi. Went here on holiday with the family and we were all impressed with the food and the service provided! A special mention to Omar who was a gentleman when serving us. Was really friendly and very informative about the food we ordered. Really worth visiting this fine establishment if you get a chance to visit Istanbul.

Words cannot explain how beautiful and special place this is. Our friends meet here for a lovely evening and the staff here were just the most humble and loving people. The food was incredibly lush with beautiful flavour, a healthy option and the chilli's we were offered from hundreds of kilometres away from Omar's home town. What a stunning night. Highly recommend this amazing restuarent.

This restaurant is a hidden gem! We were looking for an anchovy dish, and it was super fresh. The staff was friendly and attentive, creating a welcoming atmosphere. What really warmed my heart was their compassion towards stray animals, with friendly resident cats adding to the cosy charm, especially on a rainy day. It was a wonderful dining experience!

fantastic food and great service. had the best lamb chops ever for lunch one day and came back today for dinner :) the chicken dish was amazing too! everything was perfectly cooked, not dry. service was friendly and professional - unlike aggressive promoters in the area, the service crew for this restaurant were very kind.

loved the kitties that roamed around the restaurant, very cute :’)

name: Divella Bistro Restaurant
location: Cankurtaran mah. akbıyık caddesi, Cankurtaran, Adliye Sk. no:11, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
WOULD NOT RECOMMEND.

I decided to leave a review only after a few days in Istanbul to make sure I have a good idea of the culture in this area. Please do not be fooled by good reviews in restaurants here. I have learned that many are fake, and even the hotels are in on it. Hotel staff recommend places that are overpriced and obvious tourist traps, even when asked to recommend lower priced places that are less touristy.

THE REVIEW
We had lunch in this restaurant on our first day in Istanbul.

Firstly, the food is not bad but nothing fantastic. We ordered the lamb kebab, eggplant and stuffed mussels. The stuffed mussels were average. The lamb kebab was nice and tender, and the eggplant was the best of the lot.

But I am giving 1 star for three reasons.

First reason. I don’t mind being asked to leave reviews on Google Maps (I usually do anyway) but it left a bad taste in the mouth when the staff asked to mention his name in the review AND to give a 5-star review (shouldn’t this be up to me to decide). I get the impression that this is a common practice in Istanbul.

Second reason, when deciding on what to order, the staff only pointed out all the priciest stuff on the menu.

Third and main reason, our total bill came up to 2090 Turkish lira. As it was our first day there, we only had notes in 200 cash denominations, so I gave 2200, expecting a change of 110. It never came. It became a bit of a waiting game, with us sitting at the table waiting at the table, and the staff hanging around looking at us. We eventually decided to just let it go and stood up, and that’s when the guy who had been serving us quickly came over to say goodbye and open the door for us.

Horrible tactics. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND.

“Very nice place, with high-quality, delicious, homemade food. A very pleasant atmosphere. The staff took great care of us and we had a wonderful time. Thank you, Leonidas (King Caesar) , Mr. Ismail, and everyone else. With love from Greece!”

First night in Istanbul we arrived late and had the opportunity to dine in here. EVERYONE was so welcoming and patient. We weren't expecting much but was blown away at the quality of food, service and drinks which we received. We could not find anything to fault and highly recommend. We even got complimentary Baklava and tea and a SHOW!! Some locals were playing and singing amazing Turkish music which really added to the atmosphere. Great value for money despite not being cheap !
Absolutely amazing! The food was delicious. But the service was the best part. Cesar was incredibly lovely - would highly recommend!
Nice  Restaurant close to the Hagia Sophia.  Friendly and familiar atmosphere with nice service.  Good starter and main course. Thank you very much. Had a good time with you. Thank you

name: Green Garden Restaurant Cafe
location: Hoca Paşa, Nöbethane Çk. No:3, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: It’s a cute and cozy spot, and the food was tasty - but definitely not the best thing we’ve had in Istanbul. The prices felt too high for what was served. It’s the kind of place where tourists might end up paying a lot, even though you can eat just as well (or better) elsewhere for less. A decent option if it’s your first day and you just want to sit down somewhere nice, but not the best value overall.

The best restaurant we had in Istanbul. The staff and their service is amazing. Very friendly, they gave us good advice (considering we needed to avoid a lot of food it was a great choice), and they were very respectful and not pushy. Nice local design and atmosphere. We got a starter and the tea on the house. The original kebab meat prepared partially in front of us was not only very tasty but also nice to see. We got big portions and great quality. Price- quality wise absolutely a must! Highly recommended and we will come back again!

We ordered both mix meat grill and mix seafood and everything tasted amazing. Best of all is our server Mahmet which is very accommodating and intuned to our every needs.

(Swipe left on the photos to see the aftermath… 💚)

Nice aesthetics in the restaurant and service was great even though we only got takeaways. Served hot tea to us while we waited for our food to be ready. Grilled fish was meaty and tasty, chicken wings was pretty decent too. Price on the higher end, but the portions are great.

Fabulous food and lovely friendly service. Fast for 24 hours and then bring your appetite to savour the menu’s delights. If you’re feeling very brave and extra hungry try The Metre Kabab - it just about fits on the table !

name: Vamos Estambul Restaurant & Cafe
location: Alemdar, Ticarethane Sk. 39/42, 34120 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed our meals here! We ate here 3 times, as it was directly across from our hotel. The restaurant is surrounded by many other dining options, but we enjoyed this one the most…and the service was exceptional, which makes a difference. Friendly wait staff, that we enjoyed chatting with. A good variety of western and Turkish options. Thank you!!

I spent a little more than I intended, turkish people are great salespeople!
We ordered lamb kebabs which were smaller portions than the competitors but great flavor and perfectly cooked. The mushroom soup was tasty and the hummus was great after I added some lemon.
The künefe was overly sweet for my taste.
We stopped for wine.  The patio is lovely! Warned in the cold weather.  Chill vibe! Great tunes! The food on other tracks looked wonderful! And the staff so handsome!

Amazing restaurant in the heart of Istanbul!  The food is delicious and the hospitality is out of this world!!! You must go there, and make friends with Selcuk, he is super helpful and smart! We went back several times and felt right at home!!!
A nice restaurant with chilled vibes, good food and very professional and gentle service. Prices are good, alcohol is expensive as in the whole country. Good coffee too, great location.

name: Food Palace 1981 Anatolian Restaurant
location: Binbirdirek, Peykhane Cd. No: 18, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We recently visited this wonderful Turkish restaurant, and it was an amazing experience! The atmosphere is very cozy, with authentic Eastern decor, pleasant music, and attentive staff.

As for the food, it’s a true delight for gourmets. We tried several traditional dishes, and everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and perfectly cooked. The tea, served in the traditional style, was especially impressive—aromatic and strong.

The service was excellent: the staff was friendly, helped us choose our meals, and served everything promptly.

This is the perfect place for anyone who wants to immerse themselves in the flavors of Turkey and enjoy authentic cuisine. We will definitely be back!

I was looking for a nearby eatery that had mezze, something different than all the meat based food I’ve been eating since being in Istanbul. I chose this place based on its reviews, and it was a pleasant experience! Everything tasted fresh, the portions were large, and service was quick and attentive. I went when it seems to be a slow time so, (2pm during Ramadan) but I didn’t mind being the only one dining. The front is open so you get a nice breeze. Staff was nice and took time to chat with me about their family and Turkish/Kurdish history. Worth the visit!

Amazing place to eat. really good food, friendly staff, everything is very clean. 100% recommend it! we had an amazing pomegranate tea and baclava on the house. also as starters we had olives, bread and cheese also on the house.

Authentic surroundings and presentation with incredible  robust flavours. Perfectly timed courses to marinate in the joy of taste experience. Enjoyed the entire experience immensely. Our waiter Sermat was top notch.

The food was absolutely exceptional – each dish was full of rich, authentic flavors that truly reflected the essence of Anatolian cuisine. Everything was prepared with the utmost care.

The service was top-notch – the staff was incredibly attentive, and friendly. The ambiance was equally impressive, with the restaurant beautifully capturing the charm and elegance of Ottoman-era decor.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an authentic and memorable dining experience in Istanbul. A perfect blend of amazing food, excellent service, and a stunning atmosphere!

name: Seher Restaurant
location: Hoca Paşa, İbni Kemal Cd. No:18, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We were looking for a dinner spot and were pleasantly surprised by this place. The menu offered plenty of choices, and both the food and drinks were delicious. One of the dishes was served with a bit of a show — a fun and unexpected highlight that made the evening memorable.

The staff was friendly and attentive, and the tables were clean. Pricing felt reasonable considering the portion sizes and quality.

Just a heads-up: we had to pay in cash due "card machine was not working", so we had to find an ATM nearby — a bit surprising for a place like this.

Overall, a very nice experience.

Would happily return for the good food and warm service :)

I just picked this restaurant on a whim and it was a good choice. My server Aziz was great, and did a wonderful presentation on my first try at a dish called “Testi”. I was dining solo, but they made me feel very comfortable. I treat at the end of the dinner was baklava and tea, both very tasty. Would not hesitate this restaurant for a casual meal.

Overall great restaurant that mostly get its points from the quality of the food and the generous portions. They also put up a bit of show every time someone orders a "testi" kebab (no it's not made of testicles). They were also kind to offer a free baklava and Turkish tea, but overall staff were a bit rude to us and also to the cats around our table. What I really wasn't a fan of is their response and mannerism when we tried to pay by card. Despite seeing another customer going inside and paying by card they told us that their machine had a problem and pointed us to the nearest street to get to an ATM. This smelled a bit like tax evasion to me. Also while the restaurant is nicely decorated it's right on a busy street which is why I only gave a 3 star to the atmosphere.

We were VERY lucky to find this place. The service and the food were unbelievable and even came with the flame show included.

Our waiter was extremely kind and even invited us with an appetizer to start, and a tea to finish. (I'm very sorry to forget your name, but at least I remember you are a fan of River Plate!)

Five stars without even flinching.
Seher restaurant is a friendly and very nice place to eat good Turkish food in Istanbul. Aziz and his colleagues were so nice and accommodating. Amazing experience!

name: Rumeli Cafe & Restaurant
location: Akşemsettin, Fevzi Paşa Cd. No:13, 34080 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I had the pleasure of visiting this wonderful restaurant and coffee shop, and I was truly impressed by the owner’s professionalism and outstanding customer service. From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely welcomed. The attention to detail, the friendly atmosphere, and the warm hospitality made the experience unforgettable.

The food was absolutely delicious – full of flavor and clearly made with care. The sweets were just as impressive – fresh, rich, and perfectly balanced. It’s rare to find a place where both the food and the service are equally exceptional.

I really appreciate the owner’s dedication and the way he goes above and beyond to make every guest feel at home. I’ll definitely be coming back!
We had lunch there on one of the days of our vacation while strolling nearby. The food was tasty, and I had a delicious traditional tamarind drink. The service was good.
Nice cafe with a varied menu, and a very good dessert selection. The food was pretty good, and the ambience was nice.
Rumeli become my favorite place to eat! Everything tastes so good and fresh, definitely recommended!!! The staff is also super sweet and everything is very clean. Love it.
Excellent breakfast at a fair price. Lots more options on the menu to explore, will definitely be back. Peaceful, clean, and beautiful atmosphere.

name: Khorasani Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Ticarethane Sk. no 9/b, 34400 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: I was in Istanbul with a girlfriend for 2 nights and this place was so delicious that we ate here both nights. I am just sad we aren’t here for longer to taste the whole menu. It really was a fantastic meal! I can’t wait to come back. Ask for Dervis, he is the best! The staff are all fantastic. And good amazing. Get here quick before too many people find out about this amazing place! 💜

Was suggested by our guide Fatih so decided to try it.

Excellent food. The lamb shish kebab was tender and juicy.  Not dry. Delicious. Came with a generous amount of sliced cabbage.  And grilled tomato and green peppers.  Lovely. Also ordered grilled mushroom and cheese. Excellent. Topped off with Kunefe. Gave us complimentary Cai.

Unfortunately our last day in Istanbul. Otherwise would have been a repeat customer. Totally recommend.
The kebabs were divine. Watching the food prepared and served from the clay pot were delights that first time visitors to Istanbul must try.

It was our inaugural Turkish dining experience during our three-day stay. After perusing reviews, we stumbled upon this restaurant on our way. The bustling ambiance, outdoor patio diners, and enthusiastic staff chanting "this place is the best Kebap place in town" convinced us to step inside. We opted for three cups of draft beer to quench our thirst, which although plain, sufficed. For our party of six, we ordered only three main dishes as some of us weren't too hungry. Our selections included Grilled Lamb Chops, a vegetable dish, and beef kebab. Each main course was accompanied by fresh pita bread, cheese, and butter. Additionally, we requested olive oil, and they generously provided balsamic glaze as well. The standout was the Grilled Lamb Chops—lean and flavorful, perfectly complemented by rice, salad, and grilled onion and pepper sides. While slightly on the pricey side for travelers, overall, I would recommend this restaurant for its quality dishes and lively atmosphere.

We came here for the Michelin rating and were not disappointed. The clay pot with beef cubes was superb and delicious and flavorful. Staff was attentive and very friendly. After our meal we were given baklava and tea on the house that took the level of service to the next level. Definitely try them out when in town.

name: Old House Restaurant Terrace
location: Cankurtaran, Utangaç Sk. No:23, 34000 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Great lunch experience, having supreme chicken schnitzel (great sauce!) as well as a vegetarian grill plate and chicken kebab.  All great quality and very friendly staff (we switched tabled due to cold weather).  Price on the mid-high side but can be expected since it is in a very touristy area.

The food was controversial. We have ordered grilled chicken where chicken was the best chicken ever - very soft and well cooked. But on the other hand the potato in this dish was quite row and not eatable. Also we’ve ordered the aubergine kebab which supposed to be with beef meet same side of pieces as aubergine itself (according to the pictures on the menu) but we received almost only grilled aubergine with some tiny pieces of meet. More other the aubergine was awful - it was sour as if it was not fresh. So the whole dish was a disappointment. At the end we have received a free baklava as a gift so we were delighted with the service and the restaurant in general

The food is very delicious home made with great hospitality. And the rooftop terrace is direct facing to beautiful Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. The price is very competitive compare to other restaurant. Very make sense with super ambience. We will come back for lunch!

A very nice place, the owner was very welcoming, we really experienced the Turkish hospitality here. They were even kind enough to give us a taste of one of their special desserts as a gift. The food was delicious, the service was quick and very good. The atmosphere is super relaxing, having a heater right near our table outside was really great too, especially for a rainy December day.
We had a delicious meal here, including lentil soup, hummus and beef stew. We also tried the typical Turkish raki alcohol and tea. Everything was excellent! The staff was really nice to us, too.

name: Lale sultan Restaurant
location: Küçük Ayasofya, Kadırga Limanı Cd. no:108, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: We came for dinner and had the best time. The service was amazing! They looked after us so well the entire time. We took the recommendations on the food and had the best meal we've had so far in Turkey - the chicken cooked in the clay pot was delicious and entertaining to watch being cooked. Could not recommend it enough. Thank you so much!

We had a great experience at Lale Sultan through our week long stay in Istanbul. Mehmet and Atilla were very attentive to our needs and took care to accommodate my son’s milk allergy for our meals. The food was reasonably priced with good sized portions and most importantly, tasty. Also, they have the best baklava I’ve ever had!

We will definitely be back to Lale Sultan the next time we are in Istanbul!

Delicious food, large portions, very friendly staff, and a lovely lady from Georgia. Everyone was extremely kind, helpful, and attentive. We were served a starter – pita with tzatziki – and at the end, we got a complimentary baklava and black tea. Definitely worth the visit and the prices are very friendly too! Thank u! 🫶🏻

The service was excellent—friendly and attentive, making me feel right at home. I ordered the testi kebab and it was absolutely delicious! Watching it being served was such a fun and unique experience. A great spot to enjoy authentic flavors and warm hospitality on your own

The food was nice but when we checked the bill before paying, the restaurant wanted us to pay a 150TL "tax". The person that served us wanted to make us believe that every restaurant charges this tax (not true). After a discussion, he took this tax out of the bill.

name: Esto Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Çatalçeşme Sk. 29/E, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We just had something light after our Segway tour located next door. The staff was very nice.
Service was nice and atmosphere is very good.
Falafel wrap was bland.
French fries were very nice and flavorful.
Hummus was bland.
Red pepper dip was nice tasted like salsa.
Beer was standard.
Other clients ordered something in a clay pot and smelled good.  Very extensive  menu so I am sure hard to make everything well.

The place is amazing, I would highly recommend it!!! Me and my boyfriend came to dine here two times. It has beautiful design, and outside terrace with wonderful decorations. The food is very delicious, we tried few dishes and all of them were perfect. The service is excellent, we felt very welcomed, the staff is very nice and they made our experience wonderful. Thank you! Will definitely come again the next time we visit Istanbul! ❤️❤️❤️

P.S. thank you so much for the Baklava it was the best I’ve ever tried in my life!

Food was the best I had in Istanbul. I would stay in that area again just to have this restaurant close by. The customer service was on point. They go above and beyond to make you feel like you're happy. I had the salmon. Looked like I was in a 5 star restaurant! The presentation was as good as the taste. Thank you for a lovely experience x

160 tl for 2 glases of tea and 240 for service?  in the addition to the meal, which was good, but not fantastic... such things shouldn't exist... yep, service was great, very friendly man at the entrance... but... make your meal just more expensive, do not add additional "service or 2 euro for a small glass of generally free tea".

Update on response, you have a fine restaurant, and you can easily make your prices higher... you will not get less clients because of that, but please do not add any hidden fees.

waiters were very nice and welcoming, and offered to take our coats for us :) poured us some water too.

For the food, the vanilla milkshake is very nice- sweet and yummy. The wrap with the crispy chicken was very good as well, with the fries and cheese sauce. Would come here again to try the spaghetti bolognese :) It is close to our hotel as well.

name: Emek Saray Restaurant
location: Galeria Laleli, Balabanağa, Harikzedeler Sk. No:19 Kat:2, 34134 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Delicious homely Turkish fare in a hidden back street. Pide, Adana Kebaabs, and chicken wings were all delicious. We were asked if we would like our meals spicy and the flavour was subtle and so tasty. Our kids loved the food. Service was super quick and very friendly waiters. Very highly recommend this place.

My husband and I decided to have dinner here based on a recommendation from a local shopkeeper. While the food was good, it wasn’t extraordinary. That said, the service was excellent. The staff were attentive, spoke English, and easily understood our preferences for how we wanted our food prepared. We chose to sit outside on the rooftop, which was a pleasant experience, especially as there was only one other family dining at the time. The prices were on the higher side, but I might return for a quick bite the next time I visit Istanbul.

The food here was good, not the best I've had in Istanbul but still good. Service was really good and friendly and servers spoke English which was helpful for questions and ordering. Or was quite quiet even we were there eating and food service was quick. Nice little show for the clay pot dish.

A bit hidden away - but we were glad to have visited. The food was tasty, good portions and the service was very friendly. Complementary bread and dips served as an appetizer.
We would visit again!

A great place to visit.

The guy outside didn’t have to do much convincing to get us inside seeing as we had already pre-made our minds up to visit this restaurant.

It is located on the top floor of a small shopping mall but has a lovely outside area. We were the first people in at about 7am and the terrace was relaxing - a mix of flowers, soft local music and the background of birds singing - a great way to unwind after the hustle and bustle of a day in the city centre.

The waiter was friendly and attentive without pushing anything and the food was top notch.

Lovely warm pitta breads were brought regularly through the dishes. We sampled a variety of menu items (we like to order a few starters and main dishes and share between the four of us). Every single dish was tasty and full of flavour.

Little note: the clay ovens aren’t fired up on Sundays so we didn’t get to try any of the filled pittas but the other food more than made up for it.

name: Roof Panorama İstanbul
location: Kemal Paşa, Şehzadebaşı Cd. No:9 Kat:6, 34000 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I recently celebrated my husband's birthday at Roof Paranormal Restaurant, and it was truly an unforgettable evening. From the moment we arrived, everything was perfectly arranged. Our reservation was honored with a lovely window table offering a stunning view of the mosque — the setting couldn't have been more picturesque.

The service was fantastic . Our waiter was not only friendly but attentive, ensuring that everything ran smoothly. To top it off, they surprised us with a complimentary dessert and tea to celebrate my husband's special day, which was a thoughtful and delightful gesture.

The main dishes were well prepared, well-seasoned, and incredibly flavorful. The ambiance of the restaurant was warm and inviting, making it the ideal spot for a special occasion like this.

All in all, Roof Paranormal exceeded our expectations with its great food, stellar service, and beautiful atmosphere. Highly recommend it for anyone looking to enjoy a memorable meal in a stunning location.

Our dinner at the restaurant was a pleasant experience from start to finish.
Making a reservation was quick and easy through WhatsApp, which was very convenient.
Every staff member was incredibly nice, attentive, and always ready to help, making us feel welcomed.
The food was great, high quality and full of flavors. Each dish was nicely presented and tasted just as good as it looked.
We were lucky to have a table by the window, offering a stunning and atmospheric view that added to the evening’s charm.
The live guitar music was a nice touch, which beautifully complemented the tasteful food and the view.
Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience, and we would gladly return for another evening.

I can recommend this place without reservations! The location is perfect and the view in the evening is absolutely spectacular. Come here and find it yourself.
As for the food - I loved lamb chops - prepared medium and clearly as it should be.
And I recommend you to check in with Onur, whose hospitality made this evening very special!
Thank you!

I think by far the best restaurant in Istanbul. This one is the only one we were not sad to give money to. Prices are high but comparing to others really fair. Ambient perfect. Regarding the food, it isreally good, could add bit more to portions and improve a bit deserts. But overall, very good restaurant and after 5 days of looking the only one where we ate normally.
Great service, views, location. The waiters were very friendly and diligent, specially Onush. The food was delicious and typical. We’ll come back for sure.

name: Cozy Garden Fish And Meat Restaurant
location: Hocapaşa Mah. Hüdavengidar Caddesi, Hoca Paşa, Serdar Sk. No:2, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Had a great experience at Cozy Garden. The food was delicious. And the service was very friendly specialky  Salih

I had a nice lunch by myself at this restaurant, I definitely felt that it was actually extremely cozy! I had the grilled meatballs and they were delicious, the portion is definitely more than enough, especially with the free bread they give you plus olives. it's in a nice location along the street. That's not crazy busy compared to some of the other streets in the area so it can be quite relaxing, and it offers free Wi-Fi. The service is very good to and in fact when I tried to tip the waiter more, he said that it was way too much tip and refused it completely. It's definitely a trustworthy place where you don't have to feel like they will try to take advantage of you because you're a tourist 100% would return here just because of the food and service of the waiter making me feel extremely cared for not just as if I'm there for a transaction. Definitely recommend.

IF YOU DONT GO HERE YOU ARE CRAZY!
Came here with my boyfriend for a week at the hotel and ate in the restaurant EVERYDAY was the best food in Istanbul (seriously?!!) great price and value they don’t rip you off and even offer you tea or coffee for free.
