The staff were so hard working and very helpful, you can tell this is a happy work environment because the staff love talking to you! 100% recommend I don’t have enough words to describe the food so go and try it for yourself!

Salih’s service was outstanding as well as the rest of the team at the restaurant. Very kind, friendly and professional. Our food and complimentary treats were so tasty and delicious! I totally recommend this place and I will defiantly come back during my stay in Istanbul.

We decided to go to this restaurant because of high ratings on Google maps. It was worth it! The food is fresh and very tasty. Prices are appropriate to the quality and this place’s location. Very nice service! The look inside, not that nice but if you sit outside it’s very cool.

name: Erhan Restaurant
location: Binbirdirek, Klodfarer Cd. Servet Han No:29 D:29/E, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: I’ve never written a review so fast before but I’ve been in Istanbul for 2 days out of 8 and this restaurant is great, the food was delicious and great quality. The service especially was fantastic, very friendly especially if you’re a tourist. The costs were very affordable too, especially for the area. I would certainly come here again!!! Rachel and Muslam’s service was incredibly welcoming, provided incredible service. We also got complimentary tea and baklava which was even better!

We came into town at 11 AM p.m. and we’re hungry. We started to look for restaurants around our hotel and we came across this restaurant and they were about to close and the owner kindly open up his doors and serve delicious meals and great service. Cannot say good enough things about this restaurant. Highly recommended.

Amazing food and great service :)
We’ve order meza for appetizers, chicken chop and iskender kebab and it was really delicious.
The prices are really affordable and they do not charge taxes.

They were so nice to offer us baklava and tea on the house ❤️

We visited this restaurant twice in a day as my wife kept recommending the coffee. The coffee was smooth and strong and exactly what i needed to break my fasting. I ordered traditional meat testi kebab and with beef that despite being portion for 2 - i couldnt not finish. It was amazing and beef was so tender. My wife loves haloumi cheese - and salad she had was great! The host/ waiter is kind and attentive and makes the atmosphere very warm and welcoming,  chef has a great humor and easy going. Worth visiting and we will be back again!

Found this gem place from Google. Short walking distance from our hotel. Food and service were so great that we went back second time. Will definitely go back again. Thanks for the nice food and great service. Most important, there's not service charge and tax.

name: Turk Art Terrace Restaurant
location: Cankurtaran, Tevkifhane Sk. no:12, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: The Turk Art terrace restaurant is located on the top floor of the Turk art hotel building. I would describe this restaurant as being upscale. The staff is extremely professional, polite, and very knowledgeable. The views from this restaurant are absolutely amazing! Breathtaking views of the Bhosporous, the Hagia Sophia, and a glimpse of the blue mosque. You could not ask for a better view!. The restaurant is open from breakfast until late night and offers a wide variety of dishes, ranging from salads, soups, meat – lamb, chicken, beef, and fish. Very good place to stop by if you’re in the area. It’s located on the top floor so definitely not wheelchair access accessible plus there is no elevator. The prices are fairly reasonable for a restaurant of this calibre with most dishes being probably around 10 to 15 USD. They have a wide selection of fruits and wines as well. Two thumbs up from me. Great place.

This restaurant surpassed my expectations from start to finish. The semolina with molasses and Turkish apple tea were phenomenal and paired perfectly with the sea view & Hagia Sophia. We came back twice it was so good. The staff are very friendly & our waiter was extremely kind & gave us great recommendations for the rest of our trip. Turk Art Terrace is a must if you’re in Sultanahmet!

I'm coming here for the second time and I'm very pleased  I've eaten at other places in Istanbul  but this one is very good and price and taste also very good and its location is close to Hagia Sophia
The food was really good and the waiter was impeccable. Somehow the restaurant was empty so we were very lucky.

From the rooftop of this restaurant, you can get a panoramic view of the Hagia Sophia and the city. The scenery was truly beautiful. The food was delicious and reasonably priced. The waiter was always attentive, making our experience very comfortable. The owner of the restaurant also provided excellent service. If we had more time, I would have liked to check out the turquoise shop below the restaurant!

By A

name: Alemdar Restaurant & Cafe
location: Alemdar, Alemdar Cd. No:7 D:2, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
One of the best restaurants in Istanbul. Great service, perfectly cooked traditional food, impeccable service.
It is a definitely must place to eat if you are in SultanAhmet plazza.
For a central location the price is ok

Really enjoyed our dinner experience at this restaurant. Stood out for their ambience, friendly hospitality. Our server Orhe was very helpful and friendly. The fresh tortillas /Roti was a super hit for me and my husband. Highly recommend this place.
Came back to Alemdar on our second trip to Istanbul. Excellent service from Nasir and his colleagues and tasty food. The Testi Kebab is a whole experience! Hope to return again.

Fresh ingredients, perfectly blended and prepared with sincerity, the restaurant is a must visit on anyone looking for a satisfying meal in the cool city. Orhe our waiter made it extra special, ask for him if you go there…
The atmosphere was a vibe here. I love the sitting area because it’s really comfortable and chill. The food was really good and so was the Turkish tea! Would come back

name: Guney Restaurant
location: Şahkulu, Şahkapısı Sk. No:2 D:B, 34421 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Wanted a late breakfast on a Tuesday after visiting the Galata tower and this came up as a well-rated option. It allowed us to experience what seemed like normal Turkish breakfast options and we enjoyed the food and drinks. Was also a fun people watching location since quite close to the tower (but not right next to it so don’t feel like other tourists were right on top of you as you ate).

With a beautiful view of the Galata Tower, Guney Restaurant was the perfect spot for a relaxing brunch. We ordered the breakfast mezze for two, and everything was delicious. Despite being quite busy, the staff were very attentive and made sure we were well looked after. A lovely place to sit back, enjoy good food, and take in the atmosphere around the Galata Tower. Highly recommend!

This was a surprisingly good place! We needed somewhere to eat and passed by this restaurant. We thought it was going to be one of those tourist traps, expensive and mediocre food but we decided to stay for the view of Galata Tower but we were so wrong! The food was delicious! The service was great, the staff were funny and attentive and everything was cooked and seasoned to expensive. We ordered a plate each, some starters and orange juice and it was still cheaper than the restaurants down near the blue mosque. Definitely recommend! It was so yummy I forgot to take pictures before we dove in, and we finished every last bite!

Came here 3 years ago with my partner and brought my parents here again. The food is always great and atmosphere is one of the best in the area 😊 Dad can only eat well done meat and the lamb was cooked perfectly for him.

Serkan was our waiter and besides the lovely service, he helped us with choosing our wine and helped take pictures for our memories. Thank you! I will be back here again when I’m in Istanbul.

We shared this and another plate that was amazing. I'm not sure what it was, but this mix grilled plate had everything. There is so much flavor. The beer was also cold, and the view was perfect. Beautiful weather and fast attentive service.

name: Rumeli Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Ticarethane Çk. No:11, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: People are very hospitable in general, staff were friendly and accommodating. It was a rainy day, so the chicken soup really hit the spot.  I would definitely recommend!

We loved our experience here! Food was fantastic and the customer service was great. Everything was served quickly and presented beautifully, our server, Mehmet, ensured to check on us time and again and made our dinner enjoyable. Apple tea and baklava were on the house, a great way to end the evening. Loved the overall vibes of this place.

Full point to Haroon for convincing us to check out Rumeli for food. It was a satisfying experience, surely. Highly recommended! 👌👍

Amazing, authentic experience! Food was delicious. Lots of vegan options. Hookah, wine, and tea was great too. Staff is very friendly and attentive. You must get a hot pot entrée! Quite the demonstration.

Really friendly restaurant, we got some tea and baklava after our visit to Hagia sophia… all very tasteful. Great hospitality, nice friendly staff, all smiling:) we will revisit for sure to taste traditional dishes.. thank you!! 🙏🏻

The service was really good, Harun was wonderful, so helpful and kindly
My wife said the chicken dish here was the best she have eaten here in Istanbul

name: Fish Port Restaurant
location: Rüstem paşa mahallesi Yeni Galata köprüsü altı, Eminönü Haliç tarafı no 1, D:2, 34116 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Everything ia just fantastic, food atmo, service, view..
At the end when they bring us the bill we have found things that we have not ordered, please double check:

The Fish Port Restaurant is a pleasant place to be on a sunny day. It forms part of a walkway of restaurants beneath road level of the bridge. Fishing lines from the street above endlessly dip into the river below and small catches are persistently hoisted. It adds something authentically local to the experience. The food was surprisingly good, the beer welcome and it was a great place to kick back and relax for a short while.
We liked it so much that we broke our golden rule of travel and visited twice. Whoops!

We are here for our last night in Istanbul and it was such a great choice. The view was stunning and the food was so delicious. The fish soup was so yummy! The staff were very helpful and welcoming. We recommend!

In terms of price-quality ratio, this was the worst restaurant experience in my life.

In defense of the restaurant, it should be said that I was partly to blame for this: I was tired and didn’t pay attention to many things.

Let’s start with the good things: the coke was perfect and also the fries were good. But then came the lobster 🦞

Originally I wanted to take shrimps but the waiter said that the “lobster was from today and I should take it”. As I said, I was tired but I still decided to take it. So it was partially my fault, that I missed the fact that the lobster shouldn’t be in this menu.

After that the waiter, who pushed me to take it, said that “the lobster is big!” I couldn’t understand what’s wrong with it and said OK again.

I understood it later: the lobster arrived in a big plate with oil, taken out of the shell completely. The shell and also the tail shell was … served aside with a strange red liquid in three glasses. It came out as a water with a bit if a beetroot juice and leaves. „Just for the serving“. 👀

The meat was dry, overcooked, super salty and not eatable. It was also precooked. With the other words it was terrible.

But the best was the price: they charged us 6.330 lira for this so called lobster, one dorada, one coke and one fries. After I protested they started to multiply the price for 100g (750 lira) with 600g lobster I’ve never seen.

After I protested they made a “discount” and eventually we paid 5.300 (130 euros). I decided just to leave this place with no further argument, being angry and laughing at my own stupidity at the same time. I considered it as my “learning money”.

So if you’re not planning to pay such a “learning money”, just avoid this place There’re plenty of other great places in Istanbul where you can get delicious food for less than 1/2 of the sum.

Foods here are super delicious, especially chief Sinan’s fish!
Views, service are also recommended, it’s worth trying 👍🏻👍🏻

name: Hunkar kebap Restaurant Breakfast & kebap & Fish
location: Küçük Ayasofya, Kadırga Limanı Cd. No:143/A, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
A very unassuming restaurant, with friendly and attentive service. Prices are very reasonable, and the food served is tasty! Complimentary bread, Turkish tea & baklava was unexpected & much appreciated.
Erdal, the restaurant owner & his staff make dining at his restaurant, a real pleasure. Tesekkurler!

It was my first time in Istanbul and I was looking for a place to eat with my wife in the local area. We was welcomed by a lovely young man who had great service and a pleasant smile. The food and atmosphere was amazing. We ordered kebab wraps, chips and drinks. After our meal the kind gentleman then offered complimentary baklava and Turkish tea which was a very nice touch. Thank you very much, I will definitely come back here again 👏 👏

Nice little spot with good food in acceptable prices. Iskander was good, didnt blown me away, but worth trying. Free wifi available :). Fresh orange juice was really fresh and tasty 🥙👌 I can recommend this place to someone who just arrived and wants to eat nice dinner.

Bismillah, First time knowing this restaurant is from Google, and then we come for dinner today by Google Maps. It's quite famous because the taste is good and the price is affordable (than others nearby).

We have ordered : sea bass 450 TL, Meat Doner 360 TL and Spinach/ispanak 170 TL.

MasyaAllah we got a Good service and delicious food here! Alhamdulillah. The fish (sea bass) is so fresh too! (Please order this :D) They claimed too for us before we ordered.

During of waiting we got a free of bread and turkish tea. After the end of our dinner we got a free Baklava too for reviewing the restaurant on the google based on our honest experience.

By the time I write this, a few of customers come and eat here, masyaAllah. It's even not too long to wait for the food here. So you will not be stressed because of hungry and waiting too long guys hehehe

I really recommend you to come here!
Wonderful food and hospitality. We even got some free tea, baklava and turkish coffee. The portions were huge and the food very very tasty. Will go back for sure!

name: Rainbow fish & meat restaurant
location: Cankurtaran, Mimar Mehmet Ağa Cd. No:33 D:1, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We had a lovely evening here with lots of terrific food. We tried most of what they have to offer (house wine, beer, mixed drinks, soup, sample platters, salads, and a main course).

It is a colorful place with upbeat, friendly, and attentive staff. We loved all the food and even got a little show when we ordered the one special dish.

There was even a friendly cat than jumped up and laid next to me on my bench.

This place is in a fun vibrant section of the city between the Blue Mosque and the Grand Mosque. Worth the stop for a great meal.

Good meal and friendly staff. We decided to find a place near where we stay since we were quite tired for the day, so we found this place and decided to dine here. Food was pretty standard, but I especially loved the saffron vegetable dish that the server had recommended. Like most restaurants around the area, they had cute cats and great service. It can be pricey as well, but seems that most of the places around here have similar ranges.

I had lunch at Rainbow Fish & Meat Restaurant and it was an excellent experience. I ordered fish and seafood — everything was super fresh, well-seasoned, and perfectly cooked. You can really tell they use quality ingredients and take care with every dish.

The service was friendly and efficient, with staff always attentive without being intrusive. The atmosphere is relaxed, with simple yet cozy decor — perfect for a peaceful meal.

Prices were reasonable for the quality of food. Definitely a great option near Topkapi Palace if you’re looking for delicious seafood without breaking the bank. Highly recommended!

Just like all the restaurants in this area they try to lure you in. Very overwhelming experience. The food was OK, but we have had much better in Istanbul and Turkey in general. The staff is great.
They charge a service fee of 10% on top of the pretty high prices, the only restaurant we have been to in Istanbul and Ankara that did this. In return, you get some 'free' things.

In conclusion: food is OK, prices are high, staff is friendly. Definitely not the 4.9 worth.
The food was average, and so was the service. One of the staff members came off as a bit greasy. In the end, they forced a 10% service charge, which left a bad impression. Not very satisfied overall.

name: Garden 1897 Restaurant
location: Inside of Garden House Hotel, Küçük Ayasofya, Şht. Mehmet Paşa Sk. No5, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I had the pleasure of dining at Garden 1897, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The quality of the food was outstanding; every dish was crafted with fresh ingredients and bursting with flavor. The ambiance of the restaurant was equally impressive, offering a warm, inviting atmosphere that made us feel right at home.

A special thanks to Mr. Baris, whose professional and attentive service elevated our dining experience. The staff went above and beyond to ensure every need was met, showcasing their commitment to customer satisfaction and hospitality.

From the beautifully presented dishes to the impeccable service and the delightful environment, Garden 1897 truly stands out. They genuinely care about their guests, making sure every moment is memorable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a top-notch dining experience. Five stars all the way!

Came here for a very late lunch, the restaurant was still busy but had no problems getting a table for 2 without reservation. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food was delicious and the presentation was excellent.
We got the lamb cooked in the pottery for 2, I had seen a documentary about this style of cooking before so we wanted to try it and we were not disappointed. The bill came to a fairly expensive 2000 TRY per person but was worth it.
Highly recommend!

A cozy and very satisfying experience. On the internet we were not able to make a reservation. It only showed availability for later dates. We walked in and managed to find a table.

The staff were kind and polite. They carried happy smiles all around. Mr.Nadir who served our table did a great job to make sure we were leaving heartful and stomach full.

Loved the ambience of the restaurant. The food varieties were exotic and tasted delicious. Definitely worth the money.

A special shout-out to the cleanliness of the place especially the toilets. They had a censor based system that automatically changed covers on the toilet seat.

I visited this place around lunchtime today and had a meal. The interior was very clean, and the atmosphere was lovely. Since I was dining alone but ordered several dishes, I couldn’t even touch the complimentary bread that was served. I also had to skip the dessert and baklava that were kindly asked after the meal (I was just way too full at the time 😅)

Mr. Kadir, the staff member, was incredibly kind and welcoming, which made the whole experience so comfortable. Thank you so much!

This is by far the best Restaurant that we had the pleasure of eating during our visit to Istanbul.

Everything was delicious, from the stuffed grape leaves, the lentil soup... Pasta... Everything we ate was spot on. We will definitely enjoy their food again on our next visit.

Our waiter Kadir was first rate and the lovely garden around us was like a breath of fresh air in the middle of the city.

It's pricey but it's so worth it! I bet you can ask for anything on the menu and it will be so good! Definitely, definitely will be back, we loved it.

name: BirBen Restaurant
location: Eminönü, Hoybar Mahallesi, Arpacılar Cd. No:13, 34112 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
The food was good and the dishes were big enough. The site is located in a good spot, just next to the Egyptian Bazaar, so it could be a good place to stop for a quick eat.

The best part was for sure the service. Food was done quickly and the waiter was very nice with us (and he even spoke a bit of our language!).

I gave it 4 stars because there was a 10% mandatory service fee (which is perfectly indicated in the menu). Honestly, I wouldn't mind giving a 10% tip here, but I prefer it to be my decision and not a mandatory thing.

Overall a recommended spot :)

AMAZING!!

My sister and I visited this place as it was so close to Yeni Cami and grand Bazaar - it did not disappoint - staff are so nice and welcoming. The food was very local and delicious. The main reason I loved this place was the simplicity. There was no music no loud talking customers etc. it was so quiet and peaceful. I recommend for a break from the busy streets of Istanbul. You have to try the Lentil Soup, Adana Kepab and Lahmacun. I should also mention that it was much cheaper than other places I have gone - we in total spent around 360 lires so super cheap and affordable! I will definitely visit again!! Love from London!!

It’s very average place and super busy. Food was average - I would say tasteless and I had delicious Turkish food before. They target tourists as they know they will never see them again so they serve average food. Very high prices for quality of food so I wouldn’t recommend it and I will not be back. They automatically charge 10% service charge which is not mentioned in their menu so be careful. I would normally have no problem with this if their service was good but it was not.

Wonderful atmosphere with great food and excellent service. A nice spot to stop and get a quick yet delicious bite to eat and get a bit of a break from the ever so overwhelming Istanbul street vibes. Highly recommend!
Touristic restaurant. They charge 10% additionally from the bill. Its not sure if this charge is correct. The service is average and the food is so so.

name: Beso Restaurant Bistro
location: Ordu caddesi, Mimar Kemalettin, Koca Ragıp paşa CD No:7, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
During our 7 days stay in Istanbul we came here twice for dinner and I loved every single food we tried. The first time we had some kabobs and the second time we were a larger group late at night and we got seafood and kabobs. View is wonderful and service is attentive.
You need to use the elevator inside the building to get to the restaurant at the top floor.

Lovely fine dining restaurant, had a great time. Chilled atmosphere, great music with great stuff. Will call again when I'm in Turkiye🇹🇷
Prices are decent as well👌

We ordered lattes but got only milk in syrup. The wait staff insisted there is coffee in the latte, if you refer to the photos attached there's no coffee at all! How can the colour be just white? The wait staff asked if we wanted "another shot", we declined because we could not trust them. Ended up not finishing the drink and despite our complaints we still had to pay for the disgusting drink. I do not recommend this place at all. Service was terribly slow, drinks took more than 10mins to arrive despite the almost empty restaurant.

Firstly, during our 8 days self-travelling, this is the best of the best and tastiest restaurant we’ve enjoyed among Turkey. We were warmly welcomed and served in the beginning by Mehmet. He helped with passion and was super nice and friendly. Any request, he will try his best. Ex. Like mixing 3 meats in Claypot kebab but this wasn’t shown in the menu. Also helped us where to buy the best and not overpriced Turkish tea. Many local info was provided by him.

Food:
Most importantly, during the 8 days travel in turkey, this was the best food we’ve ever had in Turkey. Everything was so fresh and big portion also super tasty!!!!!! Yummy!!!!! Each cuisine we WoWed!!!!!!!! Really enjoyed and most importantly, we were served with passion. All the meat was so fresh and very well cooked. Just right that point. We will say this is the best of Turkish restaurant for us. Trust me, you will never want to miss the food in here.

Service:
You must meet with Mehmet, he was super friendly and passionate and he knows when the best to talk to you during the meal and he was aware not to always interrupt customers. It was just right. Very comfortable communication and time with Mehmet. We will definitely come back for the food and you!!! We love you!!!

Language:
We communicated very fluently with Mehmet in English, so not a problem.
Good place to eat late at night as they serve until 1.30  ! Our waitress Fatma was really helpful and kind. Really nice view also. Appropriate for a romantic dinner.

name: Rakofoli Ocakbaşı
location: Arap Cami, Kürekçiler Sok No:12, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Service was excellent. Made us feel very welcome. Food was fabulous and dessert was FANTASTIC!

Freshly grilled meat was one of the best we ever had. Nice cold appetizer recommendations. Amazing view as you would expect from a rooftop reataurant.

Service would have been 5 stars if service felt more friendly (comparing to other restos in istanbul) and dinnerware was placed gently in the proper manner. Lacked the finer touches which also made the atmosphere feel slightly unwelcomed.

Nevertheless, food and view more than made up for it.  Price for food quality and atmosphere  is  fair.

I can only agree that food and view are great. Unfortunately, the service was terrible. Firstly, part of our group received their meals much later than the others, than they increased our receipt by additional dishes that we didn't order. They added service fee they called 'tax' (which was clearly not). And at the end, they tried to scam us for the 2nd time for the part we already paid by card. All the time the waitress was rude, and in the middle of discussion she'd claimed 'she doesn't speak English'.
Tldr: food and view ok, service is FUBAR.
Really poor food, views are fine but I think there are better places in Istanbul for dinner

Food was delicious, especially the grilled meats. The lamb chops melted in my mouth. Highly recommend the lamb chops, kebab, “Shepards salad,” and Turkish pizza. The staff was very warm and welcoming, even treated us to tea. Great little rooftop with a stunning view, closed when it’s cold and open in warmer months

name: Kaya Restaurant
location: Balabanağa Mah Büyük Reşit Paşa Cad, Balabanağa, Zeynep Kamil Sk. No:13, 34134 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I left feeling quite taken advantage of! It seems like tourists are being charged three times the local rate. If you still decide to get some unflavored (really)food from here, ask to see menu prices first. I would skip this place if possible—it’s not worth the trouble when you have so many other options nearby.

To the owners: a bit more quality and some honesty could truly help you achieve long-term success.

The food is so bad, oily, not like the pics .
The soup has no flavor at all and nothing feels right the only delicious thing was the raw onion because they didnt cook it
I had a meal here last week, good food, good friendly service.

Excellent food and service, directed to the restaurant via talking to someone on the street whom directed us here. Fantastic food  absolutely delicious. Great service and hospitality. Would seriously recommend . Husband said best Lamb he's ever had, chicken kebabs gorgeous. Eat here you will not be disappointed.
Very nice restaurant food very delicious staff waiters very good service very good

name: Tin Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Yerebatan Cd. No: 29, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Loved it all, enjoyed the food and coffee after long walk. We eat dinner at this restaurant for 4 nights. The sitting setup outside is very peaceful and relaxing. Staff are very friendly and helpful, especially our host Fetih he even gave us umbrella on the rainy day. Amazing host it was nice meeting him and his colleagues. We will always remember the time spent in this restaurant.
Australia & Serbia
Although the restaurant is in a tourist area, it turns out the overall experience was more than enough, great staff, clean toilet and delicious food, I recommend it for sure

What a nice, quiet, and relaxing way to get my day started.
The food was amazing — I they taught me the proper way to drink Turkish coffee. Without that lesson, I would’ve walked away never drinking it again.
Safe place for tourists. Highly recommend.
Eggs, tomatoes, cheese was my food choice and it was amazing.
average food but some came late, service was mixed some of the servers were good some werent, prices were decent not too expensive
Great location, delicious local food and very nice staff. Recommend 10/10

name: Diva fısh kebab Restaurant
location: diva fish kebab restaurant, Cankurtaran, Akbıyık Cd. 81/A, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Excellent little restaurant. The menu was extensive,  so you shouldn't have any trouble finding something you like. The grilled calamari was fantastic! You definitely want to get katmer for dessert.  The service was good and the prices were reasonable.  You definitely can't go wrong at this place.
Very delicious food at fair prices. The staff are very friendly. We got starters, baklava and tea for free.
Good food! Well behaved staff. Nice ambiance! But the most expensive one which is cooked in the clay pot and make it hot using live fire that was not testy.
Came back 3 times in our trip to Istanbul, super delicious food with really kind hospitality. Lovely atmosphere and deco. We really enjoyed the kebabs and baklava with ice cream!
This restaurant is close to our hotel and had good reviews, so we decided to try it. We were not disappointed! The food was tasty and well cooked. The staff were very friendly and welcoming.

name: Kikirik Restaurant
location: Kemankeş Mustafa Paşa mah, Ali Paşa Medresesi Sk. No:1, 34425 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Well deserving of a five star rating. It’s rare to find all of these regional dishes at a single restaurant, especially at this level of quality. Everything was authentic, flavorful, and clearly made with care. My waiter was friendly and helped me understand the dishes and how they’re traditionally eaten, which made the experience even better.

The meal started with a trio of meze and warm bread. Each spread had its own personality and packed a punch. The soup was rich and comforting. The kitel was crispy on the outside with well-seasoned meat and rice inside. The manti was done right, with garlicky yogurt and warm butter sauce. And the rice pudding at the end was creamy and just sweet enough.

Highly recommend stopping here for a real taste of Turkish home cooking.

Must try restaurant in Istanbul! Happened to have my first meal here and made sure I’d have the last meal of my trip here. The menu is really unique - you won’t find this elsewhere. The food is really delicious and everything tastes super fresh !!
Delicious food!  Friendly and helpful owner. Loved the multitude of vegetarian options and the way they bring seasonings to the table for you to finesse the flavors to your personal taste.

Amazing! But older man took my plate when I was still eating and also took herbs which we were still using. It wasn’t comfortable at all and he is still watching you..But the young boy was super nice.

I read several good reviews about this restaurant and they were all true!
The owner and staff were very friendly, and the food was super satisfying and tasty.
I could taste all dishes were freshly cooked, homemade and full of flavor.
I also highly recommend the apricot juice.

name: Hanzade Terrace Restaurant
location: Emin Sinan, Piyer Loti Cd. No:35, 34126 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: As I sit on this restaurant, I'm reviewing it as one of the nicest places I've been to in Istanbul. Quiet and obscure, away from the busy areas. Amazing view of the sea and Blue Mosque. The atmosphere is calm. Food is spectacular. Charcoal meats and bread. Perfect portions, no need to add sides. The owner even gave us free turkish dessert and apply tea. Will definitely be recommending to others.

We had a fantastic experience at Hanzade Terrace Restaurant! Everything was perfect from start to finish. We ordered the grilled chicken, which was cooked to perfection—tender, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was warm and attentive, and to our delight, they offered us complimentary apple tea and dessert at the end. The atmosphere was cozy with a lovely view, making the whole meal even more special. Highly recommend!

Fantastic food and service. The view, the food, and the service were all perfect! A staff named Gul made our lunch feel like a warm, traditional local family-style experience. On the rooftop, no less. A superb spot. Highly recommended!

The food was great and service was good. My husband had marinated lamb and I had the shrimp. The place was small on a rooftop of a hotel. Because there were some large foreign groups, it was not as quiet as I had hoped to enjoy the view and the music was a modern fast beat. They even gave us dessert free with hot Apple tea. It was a nice surprise. I liked the reasonable price for the quality of food and the flavor as I found Istanbul fairly expensive compared to Greece.  Prices were closer or as high as the USA.
Decent meal in Istanbul with a good view. Best dish was probably the prawns cooked in tomato sauce! Rest of the dishes were solid.

editorial_summary: Easygoing eatery featuring local meat & fish plates, plus drinks, a rooftop terrace & water views.

name: BUHARA FİSH MEAT HOUSE ROOF
location: Alemdar, Nuru Osmaniye Cd. NO : 5, 34440 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: The service was fantastic and the decor was very beautiful! The food was incredible definitely recommend the spicy meat kebabs! Definitely need to try! They were so lovely and ended our meal with complimentary baklava!

If you’re looking for an unforgettable Turkish dining experience, BUHARA is the place to be. From the moment I stepped in, I was welcomed by the warm ambiance and incredible aromas that hinted at the feast to come.

I ordered the kebab, and it was, without a doubt, the best I’ve ever had. The meat was perfectly seasoned, tender, and bursting with flavor. Every bite was a masterpiece, showcasing the authentic culinary skills of the chefs.🤤

To finish, I indulged in their pistachio baklava, and it was heavenly. The layers of flaky pastry, rich pistachios, and just the right amount of sweetness made it the perfect dessert. It was so fresh and decadent, I could have easily eaten more.

Everything about my experience at BUHARA was amazing, from the attentive service to the delicious food. This restaurant sets the standard for Turkish cuisine, and I can’t wait to return. If you haven’t been yet, you’re truly missing out!

I had an incredible dining experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely phenomenal—each dish was full of flavor and perfectly prepared. What made the experience even better was the service. Burak, our server, truly stood out with his amazing personality and exceptional hospitality. He made us feel so welcome, as if we were at a friend’s place rather than a restaurant. His attention to detail and warmth added a special touch to the evening. I can’t wait to return! Highly recommend this place!
Great food and excellent ambiance. The service was also quick and efficient.
The owner is friendly. I ordered kebab and it was great with pitapan! They gave me free çay. This place is good!

name: Roof Panorama İstanbul
location: Kemal Paşa, Şehzadebaşı Cd. No:9 Kat:6, 34000 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Roof Panorama. The view is simply breathtaking — a perfect panorama of Istanbul’s skyline that creates an unforgettable atmosphere, especially at sunset. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of rich, authentic flavors. Every dish we tried was a delight.

What made the evening truly exceptional was the impeccable service. Our server, Erol, went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and taken care of. He was friendly, attentive, and professional — anticipating our needs without being intrusive. His warm attitude and thoughtful service truly elevated our dining experience.

This place is a gem — a perfect blend of ambiance, cuisine, and outstanding hospitality. Highly recommended!

I recently celebrated my husband's birthday at Roof Paranormal Restaurant, and it was truly an unforgettable evening. From the moment we arrived, everything was perfectly arranged. Our reservation was honored with a lovely window table offering a stunning view of the mosque — the setting couldn't have been more picturesque.

The service was fantastic . Our waiter was not only friendly but attentive, ensuring that everything ran smoothly. To top it off, they surprised us with a complimentary dessert and tea to celebrate my husband's special day, which was a thoughtful and delightful gesture.

The main dishes were well prepared, well-seasoned, and incredibly flavorful. The ambiance of the restaurant was warm and inviting, making it the ideal spot for a special occasion like this.

All in all, Roof Paranormal exceeded our expectations with its great food, stellar service, and beautiful atmosphere. Highly recommend it for anyone looking to enjoy a memorable meal in a stunning location.

Our dinner at the restaurant was a pleasant experience from start to finish.
Making a reservation was quick and easy through WhatsApp, which was very convenient.
Every staff member was incredibly nice, attentive, and always ready to help, making us feel welcomed.
The food was great, high quality and full of flavors. Each dish was nicely presented and tasted just as good as it looked.
We were lucky to have a table by the window, offering a stunning and atmospheric view that added to the evening’s charm.
The live guitar music was a nice touch, which beautifully complemented the tasteful food and the view.
Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience, and we would gladly return for another evening.

I can recommend this place without reservations! The location is perfect and the view in the evening is absolutely spectacular. Come here and find it yourself.
As for the food - I loved lamb chops - prepared medium and clearly as it should be.
And I recommend you to check in with Onur, whose hospitality made this evening very special!
Thank you!
Great service, views, location. The waiters were very friendly and diligent, specially Onush. The food was delicious and typical. We’ll come back for sure.

name: Pino Gare Roof Restaurant
location: Orient Express Hotel, Hoca Paşa, Hüdavendigar Cd. No : 24, 34120 sirkeci/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Had a very pleasant dinner with a gorgeous sunset view. Food was delicious and the staff were super friendly and kind ☺︎
Great views from the rooftop. Tasty food - we had meze for 4 and it was all delicious. Lovely kebabs and great staff. Located right in the center of the touristy attractions.

Pino Gare is truly a gem in Instambul!

The view from the restaurant is outstanding. But what is even better is the food. Just delicious!

I ordered the Pino Gare Special and you are always treated with some appetizers. The Special was delicious. Very juicy meat and the taste was amazing.

Afterwards we had some orange tea with some dessert and it was just the cherry on top! I really loved it.

You enter downstairs up to the seventh floor and are greeted with the most friendly service. You can’t find such good service everywhere.

I will remember this place for my future trips and can truly recommend it!
We arrived really late and they very kindly still served us. We had a great meze to start with and a nice salad and kebab afterwards. Nice glass of local wine and a cold beer. Good views.

The restaurant we chose for dinner on the last day of our trip. We made a reservation and visited, but since we arrived early, we were the first guests for dinner.

They poured us a large bottle of water over 1 liter and gave us time to choose the menu, and then served us naan bread as an appetizer.

We ordered beer and had a quick meal of beer and naan, and the main dishes came out one by one. The sea bass was cooked very deliciously without any fishy smell, and the lamb steak was so soft that it almost melted away when we chewed it.

The food was delicious overall, and the atmosphere of the restaurant was great. After we finished eating, dessert came out, and while we were enjoying simple tea and Turkish dessert, the owner came out and had a short conversation.

It was about food, and we said we were very satisfied, and we could fully understand why all 1,000 reviews of this restaurant gave it 5 stars. The taste of the food, the attitude towards customers, and the atmosphere of the restaurant made it all make sense.

If I go to Istanbul, I definitely want to visit this restaurant again.

I am very satisfied that I have this restaurant as my last memory of Istanbul.

name: Garden 1897 Restaurant
location: Inside of Garden House Hotel, Küçük Ayasofya, Şht. Mehmet Paşa Sk. No5, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I had the pleasure of dining at Garden 1897, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The quality of the food was outstanding; every dish was crafted with fresh ingredients and bursting with flavor. The ambiance of the restaurant was equally impressive, offering a warm, inviting atmosphere that made us feel right at home.

A special thanks to Mr. Baris, whose professional and attentive service elevated our dining experience. The staff went above and beyond to ensure every need was met, showcasing their commitment to customer satisfaction and hospitality.

From the beautifully presented dishes to the impeccable service and the delightful environment, Garden 1897 truly stands out. They genuinely care about their guests, making sure every moment is memorable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a top-notch dining experience. Five stars all the way!

Absolutely loved Garden 1897! The ambience is stunning — peaceful, elegant, and full of charm. The food was delicious, with amazing vegan and vegetarian options that truly impressed. The starters and the main were exceptional. Absolutely delightful and extremely flavourful meal. We even got complimentary condiments ,tea and baklava. A special thanks to Kadir, who looked after us with such care and professionalism — top-notch service. One of our favorite dining experiences in Istanbul and will be in our cherished memories for a long time.

Came here for a very late lunch, the restaurant was still busy but had no problems getting a table for 2 without reservation. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food was delicious and the presentation was excellent.
We got the lamb cooked in the pottery for 2, I had seen a documentary about this style of cooking before so we wanted to try it and we were not disappointed. The bill came to a fairly expensive 2000 TRY per person but was worth it.
Highly recommend!

A cozy and very satisfying experience. On the internet we were not able to make a reservation. It only showed availability for later dates. We walked in and managed to find a table.

The staff were kind and polite. They carried happy smiles all around. Mr.Nadir who served our table did a great job to make sure we were leaving heartful and stomach full.

Loved the ambience of the restaurant. The food varieties were exotic and tasted delicious. Definitely worth the money.

A special shout-out to the cleanliness of the place especially the toilets. They had a censor based system that automatically changed covers on the toilet seat.

I had a great experience here. At first getting there seemed a bit uncertain - the area was a bit empty but that could have been because it was raining, but once you are there it’s great! The restaurant is inside a hotel, the area is very clean and the staff super nice. Our server Riza went above and beyond for us during our meal. We had the mixed mezze which was delicious and also very filling. We ended up just having that and the meat balls and canceling the chicken dish because we were already so full - the flavors of the food were really great and everything felt very fresh, which was very nice. I really enjoyed our lunch there and would recommend it to anyone looking for a good spot to eat away from the crowds after visiting the main attractions o. This side of Istanbul.

editorial_summary: Traditional small plates & mains served in a relaxed venue with a garden & a terrace.

name: Hidden Garden
location: Binbirdirek, Peykhane Cd. No: 14/A, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Hidden Garden Restaurant is a true hidden gem in the heart of Sultanahmet. As soon as you step into the garden, you’re welcomed by a peaceful, green atmosphere that feels like a calm retreat from the city’s hustle and bustle. The lush plants, charming decor, and cozy seating create a relaxing environment perfect for both lunch and dinner.

The food is equally impressive. The menu offers a wonderful selection of Turkish and Mediterranean dishes, each prepared with care and fresh ingredients. I especially enjoyed the mixed meze platter and grilled lamb skewers – both full of flavor and beautifully presented. The portions were generous, and everything tasted homemade and authentic.

The service at Hidden  Garden is truly outstanding. The staff are friendly, attentive, and very knowledgeable about the menu. They made sure we were comfortable throughout our meal, offering helpful suggestions and checking in at just the right times. Their hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable.

Whether you’re a tourist exploring the historical sites nearby or a local looking for a relaxing meal, Giden Garden is the perfect spot. I highly recommend it for anyone seeking great food, warm service, and a beautiful garden atmosphere.

Wonderful food. Great service from Sakir, Mario, Can, and the rest of the staff as well. Good atmosphere for us to rest, relax, and enjoy ourselves after a long day of walking around the city. Shout out for the complementary coffee & Baklava to close out this nice dinner.

Highly recommended!

Will definitely come again.

Came here due to the reviews and glad we did. Great Turkish restaurant with fantastic service and flavorful authentic food. We sat outside in the back and it was chilly but beautiful. Plus they had plenty of heaters around to make it comfortable. The bread was so fresh and delicious! Really enjoyed both entrees we got. And our service was fantastic with our server Percot - he was very accommodating and kind. Highly recommend!

Sakir was such a wonderful person to chat with while I was here! Made me feel very welcome into Hidden Garden. Also the place has such a cute ambiance and is truly a hidden gem. I love places that are tucked away like this. I saw the door but when I went inside and down the stairs it opened into this beautiful patio surrounded by plants. I loved it. The food was superb and they make the best sangria I have had.

After more than 20,000 steps of roaming around Istanbul yesterday, we decided to try Hidden Garden Restaurant to cap off the day. We ordered the Hidden Garden Pastry, Adana Kebab, Sultan's Favourite beef and two glasses of beer.

The Hidden Garden Pastry was such a great starter. The cheese and honey combo was so good. The Adana Kebab was juicy and full of flavour, and the chips were really crispy. The Sultan's Favourite beef was tender and tasty, and everything on the plate worked so well together.

The staff were also incredibly hospitable, which made the experience even better. 🙂

Will we visit again? Definitely!

name: OLD KONAK CAFE RESTAURANT
location: Balabanağa, Büyük Reşitpaşa Cd no:10/A, 34134 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Looks traditional, but hides a scam – be careful!

This was our first meal after arriving in Turkey, and unfortunately, it left a bad impression. We ordered a few regular items – lemonade, a milkshake, grilled vegetables, lamb chops, and an “Ottoman Anatolian kebab” – and the total bill was an outrageous 4470 TRY (about $124 or €112).

At first, we weren’t familiar with local prices and assumed it might be normal. But just a day later, we realized that this price is far above the average for similar food in Istanbul.

The environment is average, the ingredients are nothing special, and the food quality is mediocre. Based on all that, this meal simply does not justify such a high cost. There’s a huge gap between what we paid and what we actually received.

It’s clear that this restaurant is taking advantage of tourists who haven’t had a chance to understand local pricing yet. We felt tricked and disappointed.

Avoid this place – there are many better, more honest restaurants nearby with fair prices and better food.

Great buzzy restaurant,  we enjoyed our first meal there we went back for our final night.
Service was friendly and efficient and good fun. The food was delicious,  there was a great choice and prices sensible.
The clay pot kebabs were delicious and came with no small amount of added theatre
Great place to go for Turkish food. We went there multiple times for both lunch and dinner. Very friendly and professional staff.

We had such a lovely and enthusiastic experience! Definitely recommend for a real turkish experience. Prices are just above average but well worth it! I recommend the chicken clay pot, not only delicious but a real show put on - wait and see! Complimentary bread starters and tea at the end.
Best place in Istanbul to eat, amazing food and atmosphere. The guys are really friendly and go above and beyond to make you feel welcomed.

name: By Chef Restaurant
location: No:27Hoca Paşa, Ebussuud Cd., 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Delicious food, great atmosphere and exceptional service! I wanted to try Turkish wine and they recommended a perfect Chardonnay to go with the fabulous  creamy seabass fish that was also recommended. My aunt is gluten-free and she was able to enjoy the fish as well. Everything was extremely fresh and enjoyable. The atmosphere is relaxed and pretty with nice Turkish music playing in the background as well. I 100% recommend this place and look forward to returning. 😋

What a delicious restaurant and it was just down the street from my hotel. The place has a great atmosphere and the service was great. I really enjoyed the lamb, but I bet everything is good. Their menu is extensive,  so there is something for everyone.  The guys working in the place were very friendly.  I would definitely come back.

Fun and tasty dining experience in the Sultanahmet area. We stopped in for a meal and refreshment after a lengthy self guided tour of the palace. The staff here are great and the atmosphere up in here is gives me chill and intimate vibes. Sort a of a tucked away view of the street, and is a great place to refuel and get a plate. I recommend.

Came here on my first night, and everything was great. The food was delicious, and the free appetizers they bring out were generous and really tasty. After the meal, they offered me pomegranate tea and baklava. Everyone was so nice, generous, and friendly, truly showcasing that famous Turkish hospitality. Highly recommend, 10/10!
Really friendly and professional service. The dishes they recommended were delicious and well prepared. Atmosphere clean and cozy.

name: FÜLANE RESTAURANT
location: Hoca Paşa, Dervişler Sokağı No:7 D:2, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Tried an iskender kebab in here. It was finger licking good. Nice terrace, you can see cat sometimes, but that don’t bother you. Staff is really welcoming. In the evening was cold weather, but due to heating it was warm even on terrace.

I loved everything about Fulane restaurant, its ambience,the soft lighting, and the food.  I ate too quickly and forgot to pause for a photo. The chicken salad was delicious and so was the ravioli. I enjoyed tasting Turkish beer and wine. I highly  recommend dinner in this restaurant. The fruit teas were a welcome  treat.

While in Istanbul, we had dinner at Fulane Restaurant, and it was a delightful experience. The atmosphere was peaceful, making it a perfect spot to unwind after a day of exploring.

We started with a mix of cold meze, served with warm flatbread—fresh and flavorful. For the main course, we had grilled sea bream, cooked to perfection with generous portions. Dining outdoors made the experience even more enjoyable, especially with a few friendly cats keeping us company!

Although we initially skipped dessert, the restaurant surprised us with a complimentary rice pudding to share—a thoughtful and heartwarming gesture that truly elevated our experience. A lovely place with great food and hospitality—definitely worth a visit!

Food and service were very good. Delicious foods, big portion. Baklava and tea as a gift
10/10⭐️🎁

A total gem of a restaurant close to the mosques and the palace. Great food, cocktails, service and gorgeous and friendly cats!
Turkish and Anatolian dishes we had were great, especially ottoman casserole. Iskinder , tabulle and kofte also fab. Thank you for the baklava on the house.
Cats rule in this restaurant - very friendly and cute - but they are looked after so don’t ask to play or be fed.

name: Loti Roof Lounge
location: Binbirdirek, Divan Yolu Cd. No:27, 34112 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: It offers a good panoramic view of Istanbul, making it a pleasant spot to relax. The service is attentive and friendly. However, the food quality doesn’t quite match the high prices. While the ambiance is appealing, the dishes lack the freshness and flavor expected at this price point. It’s a decent place for drinks and to enjoy the scenery, but if you’re seeking a memorable dining experience, you might be left wanting more.

I absolutely love this place. I’ll start my review fully disclosing I’m only in Istanbul because of this lounge. After traveling in Morocco and Egypt, I could have went home from Egypt. Loti Rooftop’s social media presence caught my I for their shisha/hookah presentation skills. I been here 2 of my 3 day stay. Both nights I had dinner, cocktails and shisha. All were a 10/10 experience. The food is very tasty. The cocktails were delicious, and the Shisha out did Morocco and Egypt combined! All staff are were very friendly and kind. The ambience and decor is very welcoming and relaxing. Everything was very clean. I’m so happy I made this choice and would recommend. I almost forgot to mention the view, spectacular!
Had the best experience at Loti Rooftop! Metin was such an amazing waiter and made the experience for us! Lovely food. Would 💯 recommend.

Our server was Metis who was very polite and he helped us choose the most perfect dinner for the whole family. The food was very delicious and we all loved it. The scenery is beautiful and we had a panoramic view over the whole city. The music is great and it's a very gentle place.

This was probably the most fun restaurant in Istanbul I went to during my trip! I loved the music they were playing, the vibe, and the food! Pizza was super good and the rest of our group were happy with their dishes too. I recommend definitely get a table at the rooftop , not the first floor !

editorial_summary: International fare & cocktails offered in a sophisticated restaurant with panoramic city views.

name: Galata Sanat Restaurant Galata Köprüsü
location: Haliç tarafı, Rüstem Paşa, Galata Köprüsü altı no : 6, 34116 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Tldr; like someone said this is a tourist trap. Price vs quality not worth it.

Personal opinion: I feel this place is paying for reviews otherwise I don't see how they have such high score with such average food and service.

The food is average, the service is poor and the location is nice.

We got rushed in and the server kept pushing us to order. We asked for advice and he seemed rushed to get us to close the deal. The fish in the window did look fresh which was a good sign and the reason we stayed. We ordered sea bass grilled and you can see from the pics this did not seem grilled. On top of that the server never provided the weight for the fish and charged us 2100 which was the price per kilo. Judge for yourself if that was 1kg of fish from the pic maybe we're wrong but definitely didn't seem like it.

The salads were just not good therefore we left them out.

The anchovies were quite good actually and did seem fresh. Sadly that was the only highlight of the entire evening.

Lovely aspect of the Bosphorus with lots of food options.

Really enjoyed the Sea Bass and skewered Lamb.

The Kunafe is out of this world and must be tried.

Service was good and nothing was too much trouble for them.

Being at a tourist destination, you sometimes get stung with extraordinary pricing and disappointing food...

Galata Sanat does not disappoint and leaves you wanting more!!

Foods are delicious and the portions worth of money, staffs very kind and even give us free baklava n tea. Its our second time here and definitely will come back again! Lamb and meatballs so tasty! Thank you for the good ambiance live music good food n good people 😁

1. The place everyone has to visit in Istanbul, under the Galata bridge
2. Big portions, reasonable price
3. Tasty, but meat was a bit dry
4. Nice and friendly staff
5. Wonderful views
Recommend

The place is perfect, the food, the fish is fresh and delicious. They gave us additional discount and free day and baklava as desert. Most of all we have very nice service and hospitality from Hasan. We definitely come again if we visit Istanbul next time.

name: By Ferro Kebab And Fish House
location: Emin Sinan, Kadırga Limanı Cd. No:85, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: This is a fun and friendly Turkish restaurant with great food and kind service. They staff are very attentive and take good care of you while dining. They make it a fun experience and also provided baklava and tea on the house. Highly recommend the grilled meat platter for a group of people.

Experienced the most delightful turkish hospitality with the most delicious authentic food, loved the mixed grill platter, they served the epitome of everything sumptuous for our first day in Turkey 😋👌🏼🇹🇷
Fantastic kebabs! The baklava was delicious! But the service and atmosphere were top notch! Great food and fun time! Highly recommend!

This restaurant staff were really sweet to my nephew. They gave him all the attention he wanted and gave him free snack at the end and tea for the adults. Very delicious food. And the restaurant vibe is really pretty.

We got here late on Saturday after a long bus trip to Turkey. The children were hungry so we decided to get a quick food for them without paying much attention to the price. We were charged 440 lira for a small plate of fried potatoes, 330 lira for a can of sprite. The kids ordered a salad and pasta and both of them came with chilli sauce on the plate which the children thought was tomato sauce so that didn't go well with them. The place is next to the main road so it was very busy with lots of cars passing by. We charged over 4100 lira for 4 soft drinks, 1 wine, 1 plate of fried potatoes, 1 plate of salad, 1 plate of cheese rolls. They gave us "free" tea and baklava when we asked for the bills.

name: The First Ottoman Lounge
location: Muhsine Hatun, Samsa Sk. No:4, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: My friends & I (a group of four) very good time here at Ottoman lounge. We had food, drinks and hookah. The food has been great & the hospitality has been spot on. Salim has been very accommodating and catered to our group making us feel welcomed. And the price to service /food ratio is EXCELLENT ! We highly recommend.

The staff here are awesome!  So kind, fun, and accommodating.  Very comfortable chairs, nice food selection, and the best Turkish coffee we had, and in one of the coolest neighborhoods we encountered in all our walking around Istanbul.

I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The staff was incredibly welcoming, polite, and attentive, which made the visit even more enjoyable. Their hospitality truly stood out.

The food was tasty and well-prepared, with fresh ingredients and nicely balanced flavors.

Overall, it's a place I’d gladly recommend for both the service and the overall atmosphere.

Had a great experience at the ottoman lounge. Great service, succulent meals and delightful shisha. The seats were very cosy as well! I highly recommend for visitors to Istanbul to give this place a try!
The dishes are made of fresh products. The meat is very little in the portion, the rest is great. Thank you for your kind welcome. In winter time, a lovely terrace heated by stoves

name: Old Ottoman Cafe & Restaurant
location: Alemdar, Cağaloğlu Hamamı Sk. No:17 D:J, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
I really loved the dessert they gave us — it was the best I’ve had in any restaurant! The stew in the clay pot was a bit pricey and the portion was small, but the taste was great. There’s no service charge here, but the total price still isn’t exactly cheap.

The service was excellent. I really liked the smiles of the two brothers — we had great conversations over several days. Overall, I’m very satisfied. Highly recommended!

Excellent food for decent prices. As a tourist, my family and I tried a lot of Turkish food that lacked flavor and freshness, this restaurant had both. The flavors were incredible and there were so many excellent vegetarian choices. The staff were so kind to offer complimentary tea and dessert. If you come to Istanbul, you HAVE to eat here. What a lovely meal to end our trip. Thank you for the best food we had in this city!

Dishes in photos: Sultan’s vegetarian favorite, vegetarian clay pot kebab, fig dessert and semolina with ice cream

We had an amazing dining experience at this restaurant – by far the best in Istanbul! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The service was impeccable, and the food was nothing short of exceptional. Every dish was bursting with flavor and aroma; you could tell they use only the freshest ingredients. We truly enjoyed every bite and the whole experience. If you’re in Istanbul, this place is a must-visit. Can’t wait to return!

I had an exceptional dining experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely phenomenal, with each dish surpassing my expectations. The standout dish for me was the Oriental Clay Pot Kebab. Not only was it served in a unique and theatrical way that felt like a show, but the taste was out of this world. The combination of flavors and the tender meat made it a memorable highlight of the meal. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I highly recommend trying the Oriental Clay Pot Kebab if you visit!

Everything was amazing. The atmosphere was very cozy and warm, which was nice on a cold night. The staff was very attentive and helpful in explaining what all the dishes were. The food itself was also amazing.  My husband and I split the clay pot kebab with beef, and it was plenty of food for the both of us.  On top of that, the presentation of the dish was super cool! The desserts were all amazing, but my favorite was the katmer, I'd never tried it before, and it was so good. Definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for great food, great service, and a great atmosphere!

name: Food Palace 1981 Anatolian Restaurant
location: Binbirdirek, Peykhane Cd. No: 18, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We recently visited this wonderful Turkish restaurant, and it was an amazing experience! The atmosphere is very cozy, with authentic Eastern decor, pleasant music, and attentive staff.

As for the food, it’s a true delight for gourmets. We tried several traditional dishes, and everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and perfectly cooked. The tea, served in the traditional style, was especially impressive—aromatic and strong.

The service was excellent: the staff was friendly, helped us choose our meals, and served everything promptly.

This is the perfect place for anyone who wants to immerse themselves in the flavors of Turkey and enjoy authentic cuisine. We will definitely be back!

I was looking for a nearby eatery that had mezze, something different than all the meat based food I’ve been eating since being in Istanbul. I chose this place based on its reviews, and it was a pleasant experience! Everything tasted fresh, the portions were large, and service was quick and attentive. I went when it seems to be a slow time so, (2pm during Ramadan) but I didn’t mind being the only one dining. The front is open so you get a nice breeze. Staff was nice and took time to chat with me about their family and Turkish/Kurdish history. Worth the visit!

Authentic surroundings and presentation with incredible  robust flavours. Perfectly timed courses to marinate in the joy of taste experience. Enjoyed the entire experience immensely. Our waiter Sermat was top notch.

Best meal we've had on our first day in Istanbul. We spent time in Antalya and Cappadocia but this was the first meal that blew our minds. Sermet, our waiter for the night was extremely nice and helped us choose from the menu. We also got served with homemade baklava and apple tea after our meal on the house. 10/10 would come again.

Attracting ambience and food were delicious.
Restaurant gets busy with tourists.

Great customer service. They accommodated our special requests.
Manager and servers were very kind and respectful.

Food tried:
Sac Kavurma
Pina Colada
Ali Nazik
Black tea

They gave us complimentary Baklavas.

Would totally revisit this place if around and recommend this place to others.

name: Deraliye Terrace
location: Alemdar Mahallesi Ticarethane Sokakk. No:10 Teras Kat, Alemdar, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We had Turkish breakfast there.
Food is okay - nothing special for what we ordered. Also view is beautiful, but there are places with better view

Service made it different and was really exceptional!
Unfortunately I don’t remember waiter’s name, but he was more than professional, he was excellent!
Beautiful view from the terrace. The food was good, we tried variety of meals. They have the best Katmer I have tried, with the very tasty icecream. Highly recommend for the expierence

Absolutely amazing meal at Deraliye Terrace with a stunning views of the Bosphorus, the Blue Mosque, and the Hagia Sophia.

Food was delicious and deserving of the Michelin recommendation. Staff were very attentive and hospitable, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Would recommend and would return!

The best food we tried in Istanbul! The taste is so rich we were mesmerized 🫰🏻
We had a Lamb Beyti Kebab with vegetables for a kid, the meat was tender. Kavun Dolmasi (Staffed melon) blowed my mind with mix of tender meat, nuts and berries with melon! The other dish Kuzu Incik (Lamb Shank) was also mouthwatering, mashed Aubergine complemented the meat perfectly 👍🏼
We also had a fruit plate, which is very large and of various fresh fruits!

The atmosphere was clay, with nice music, gentle waiters (some also speak Russian) and surely an amazing panoramic view 🧡

We will be back to this restaurant next time!

Absolutely delicious food! This is by far the nicest restaurant in the street. Great for a special occasion or romantic meal. We were seated outside but the inside looked lovely (recommend booking). Staff are incredibly attentive - the waiter saw a fly land in my cocktail before I did and replaced it for free- and food was the best we had on our holiday.

name: Sirkeci Lokantası 1912
location: Hobyar, Rahvancı Sk. No:5, 34112 Sirkeci/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
We came across this beautiful restaurant by chance after a long stroll through the bazaar. The beverages were refreshing and the desserts are absolutely delicious. Definitely try the Pistachio Brownie which is great for sharing.

The music is upbeat and the restaurant is absolutely beautiful -reminscent of an upscale Parisian restaurant. Thank you to the team who are very hospitable too!

İ came here with my friend from The Netherlands here for the first time for dinner the food and service was fantastic! The atmosphere was very chique. We would like to thank the lady responsible for restaurant guest relations for her interest.❤️❤️❤️🙏🙏

The restaurant is a beautiful historic building that has incredible curb appeal, especially at night with the lighting. The restaurant was not busy when we visited. The decor, atmosphere, and lighting was beautiful and relaxing. Nice jazz music was playing. Service was slow and they forgot our Hummus order - came late and did not include any bread or preferably pita bread (maybe that is not the culture in Turkey, but wasn’t sure how to eat the hummus without any bread). The soup of the day was cream of zucchini, which was excellent. I had a beef tenderloin kebab, which was very expensive and just ok and a small portion considering there were pieces of fat between the meat, which I assume was there to keep it juicy. The side salad was a very large portion and very tasty and fresh. The meal was nearly $100 and consisted of beef tenderloin kebab,soup of the day, hummus, bottled water, and side salad.
Really nice environment, service and food! And the lady welcoming the clients took me pictures and is very kind!
very good attention, cocktails and food is great. We would like to thank the lady responsible for the guest relations,Gul, who welcomed us with a smile

name: Sirkeci Nova Roma Restaurant
location: Hoca Paşa, Serdar Sk. No :3, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: This is our second time at the restaurant, we absolutely love the pasta. The Chefs are lovely. They come to your table and suggest delicious food if you have no idea what to try first. So far the recommendation that they gave to us were absolutely delicious. If you come to the city definitely try this restaurant, you won't be disappointed.
Great food, great service. The people working here are SOO nice. The food was absolutely delicious!!
The food is very delicious! Service is really nice and the environment is good!

Delicious food and atmosphere here!
Reasonable price and nice food!
Friendly staff in here~

We were looking forward to dining here given the positive reviews, (that now seem fake).

The atmosphere was decent, and the staff was friendly, music was tastelessly playing off key covers of 2010 pop songs… The food didn’t live up to expectations. The homemade bread was delicious, the falafel was subpar, my wife order a traditional Turkish dish that was good, and the steak was the most overpriced steak I’ve had in a long time (and over cooked). For the price point I was expecting more consistency across the board. It’s a good restaurant, but not the exceptional experience I had hoped for.

The “on the house” complimentary food is a nice touch but they add a 10% service fee to the bill which contradicts the free hospitality.

At the end of the day I understand everything is expensive due to the economy in Turkey and everyone needs to make a living. But for the price the quality did not match.

name: Eva Bosphorus Restaurant
location: DEMİRAY OTEL'İN ÜST KATINDA BULUNMAKTADIR, Hobyar, Hocahanı Sok. No:10, 34112 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Fantastic restaurant with an amazing view! We had mezze, grilled meat platter and grilled sea bass, all really tasty. The views are stunning out over the bospherus and over to galata tower. We even came back the next night for dinner! Thanks to Serdar, Sezar and Ismail for the fantastic service!
The place is fantastic and cozy. Well organised and clean. Service crew were nice and friendly. Food is delicious and price is affordable. 360 view of Bosporus. Well recommended. Five thumbs up!

From the restaurant's terrace, you can overlook the entire Bay Area while you enjoy your meal. This makes it the perfect spot for great pictures. It is not our first time in Istanbul, but it is our first time spending an entire week here. So, come and visit this spot if you want to see how immense Istanbul really is.

The ambiance at the restaurant is very pleasant. Music is playing all the time, but it only adds to the atmosphere and it is never so loud that you couldn't have a conversation.

The breakfast buffet has much to offer: fresh fruits, salads, and vegetables, as well as eggs, cheese, and many other Turkish specialties. Whether you prefer a cold or hot breakfast, I am sure you will find the right combination for your breakfast. An absolute delight.

The staff is super friendly, even if some of them don't speak English or just a few words. They will always do their best to accommodate you and fulfill any wishes and requests you may have, given that they are within reason, of course. Especially Efe was super attentive and always looking to provide good service to make us feel as comfortable as possible. If we come back again, we would for sure eat here again.

We stayed at Demiray Hotel for several days and visited this restaurant several times, for both breakfast and dinner and each time we really enjoyed it. The breakfast buffet is extensive and with excellent variety. At dinner, the atmosphere is relaxed but elegant, and the dishes are beautifully presented. Special thanks to Umit and Hayrettin for their attentive and friendly service. As for the view from the terrace, it simply cannot be any better. I could spend hours there taking in the huge number of things to look at from that vantage point.

If it was possible to give a higher rating - they would put

We came to this wonderful place on the first day of our arrival in Istanbul and knew for sure that we would definitely come to the last one again! That’s how it was and both times we met all our expectations for all 100

The service is amazing, the food is delicious, the rice is the best in all of Turkey. Many thanks to Sardar and the team for the warm welcome and very pleasant emotions!

name: Old hipodrom terrace restaurant
location: Küçük Ayasofya, Kaleci Sk. No:3, 34000 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Beautiful place! Food amazing and tasty!
Will come back for sure!
Sultan portion is the best! What an amazing combination!🤗💞
Best regards from Serbian girls!

We came to Old Hipodrom 3 nights in a row as their food is amazing and they had beer and wine. Not every restaurant in this area serves alcohol so this was the most convenient for us to have great food (and quite the selection such that I had a different main course each evening) and drinks in the same place! Their service was also amazing and they provided several complimentary items with our meals such as hot bread, mezze, Turkish tea, and delicious Turkish delight!! We bought a massive box of Turkish delight to bring home with us too! Highly recommend visiting this restaurant!

After traveling all day from the states we walked over and the service was very warm and welcoming. We ordered a seafood platter that was amazing! We were given some desserts which were also amazing. Their tea at the end of dinner was the cherry on top.

The food and service is amazing!  We purposefully walked here after exploring the area.  It has a mix of local and tourists.

The fire coals claypot lamb was the highlight for us! Even the mini dumplings hit the spot.

A place we plan to come back to!

I was kinda afraid of the 5 star reviews. But I can confirm it isn't a scam! The restaurant has really good turkish food. Even if it is small, it has a nice atmosphere, good food and variety (they have vegetarian and even vegan options too). The prices are okay, however note they aren't the cheapest. They offer free meze in the beginning. At the end they also bring free tea.

name: Gülhane Şark Sofrası
location: Alemdar, Alayköşkü Cd. No:22, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Best restaurant experience I had in Istanbul. It’s close to the tourist hotspots and the prices reflect that, but the food and service make it absolutely worth it! I came in alone and asked if I could sit with the cats they had roaming around, and they brought out three little kittens to cuddle with me while I dined. 🥹 the food was delicious and they give you lovely freebies, they even brought me extra tea while I sat there for ages with the kittens. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

Unassuming, rustic, generous and warm. Adjectives well deserving of this gem of a restaurant. Right off the bat, they offered complimentary home made dips with fresh breads that are perfect and amazing. And when I simply ask for guidance that I don’t over order for a solo diner like myself, they were wholly attentive and ran thru items of the menu with care to ensure they meet the brief. And when my appetiser and main arrived, it was simply spectacular. My salad is fresh and well portioned while the beef with eggplant surprisingly light yet so flavourful. Service wise, they are friendly and more importantly, attentive. Highly recommended.

This restaurant is a hidden gem for anyone who wants to experience real Turkish cuisine! From the outside, it might not stand out, but once you step inside, you’ll be treated to an unforgettable dining experience.

The food is absolutely delicious – fresh, authentic, and full of flavor. Every dish is prepared with care and passion, and you can taste the quality in every bite.

The service is outstanding! The team is young, energetic, and incredibly friendly. They truly care about their guests, always making sure you feel welcome and taken care of. Whether you need a recommendation, have a special request, or just want a warm smile – they are always there for you.

The atmosphere is unique and special. The walls are covered with thank-you notes from visitors all over the world – proof of how many people have loved this place!

And the prices? Absolutely fair for the amazing quality and service you get.

If you are in Istanbul and want to enjoy great food and true Turkish hospitality, this is the place to go. We will definitely come back!

A jewel in the crown of Turkish restaurants! Excellent food provided by the folk at Gülhane Şark Sofrasi. Went here on holiday with the family and we were all impressed with the food and the service provided! A special mention to Omar who was a gentleman when serving us. Was really friendly and very informative about the food we ordered. Really worth visiting this fine establishment if you get a chance to visit Istanbul.

This restaurant is a hidden gem! We were looking for an anchovy dish, and it was super fresh. The staff was friendly and attentive, creating a welcoming atmosphere.
